Resonator Yinlin's waveform graph shows zigzag fluctuations. The pattern of Time Domain is irregular. Both the upper and lower peak values are high and manifest proximity to the Criticality level. The waveform displays segments of partial fuzziness and abnormal waveform can be seen.

Resonant Criticality: Relatively low, with low stability. Risk of Overclocking remains.

Resonator Yinlin has no recorded history of Overclocking. Her body shows physical strength, but also signs of prolonged Overclock-inducing item exposure. Needs further monitoring.

Judging from the observations so far, the risk of Overclocking is minimal. Resonator Yinlin is advised to avoid strenuous activity and erratic schedules.

entries.name: Yuanwu Forte Examination Report
entries.content:
Resonance Evaluation Report
Resonance Power: Fists of Thunder

Evaluation Basis [Resonance Assessment 1425-G]

The exact time of Resonator Yuanwu's Awakening is unclear. Resonator Yuanwu recounted that he was exposed to powerful electrical energy for extended times before his Awakening. Resonator Yuanwu's Tacet Mark is located on the right side of his neck. After his Awakening, blue crystal-like structures appeared on his front limbs, with scar-like tissue visible on his hands and wrists. These changes have since stabilized. Resonator Yuanwu has extraordinary control over the frequency fluctuations of his body. He can engineer the amplitude and range of his frequencies in an instant, seemingly without doing any harm to himself. Tests have concluded that he is 82.58% more proficient in manipulating frequencies than the average Resonator.

The Resonance Spectrum Pattern of Yuanwu has been observed to align closely with that of thunder. A strong Syntony reaction has been observed, yet the cause of Yuanwu's Awakening remains unclear. Analysis of test samples has revealed a non-convergent Rabelle's Curve with a gradual rise. Resonator Yuanwu is thereby classified as a Natural Resonator.

Overclock Diagnostic Report
Resonator Yuanwu's waveform graph shows elliptical fluctuations. Pattern of the Time Domain appears stable with no abnormal waveforms observed.

Resonant Criticality: Relatively high. Resonator Yuanwu's frequency displays high stability with minimal risk of Overclocking. Previous records indicate no history of Overclocking; however, in Resonator Yuanwu's adolescence, during the earliest recorded use of his Resonance Ability, there was a near Overclocking event that produced violent frequency fluctuations and uncontrolled behavior. The incident was classified as a Class 2 hazard and archived under code EX42978. Subsequent examinations revealed that this episode was caused by emotional distress. No aftereffect of Overclocking was noted. Presently, Resonator Yuanwu's psychological state is deemed stable and healthy. Routine examinations are advised to prevent future incidents of Overclocking.

entries.name: Xiangli Yao Forte Examination Report
entries.content:
Resonance Evaluation Report

Resonance Power: Matter Weaver

Evaluation Basis: [Resonance Assessment 2603-G]
Resonator Xiangli Yao's awakening occurred two years ago, following an incident at the Court of Savantae Ruins where he lost his arm and came into contact with an unknown metal substance. Resonator Xiangli Yao's Tacet Mark is located on his prosthetic right arm. Post-Awakening observations revealed his ability to perform Metalmorph by manipulating the shape and storing energy of his prosthetic arm. The Resonance Spectrum Pattern of Xiangli Yao has been observed to align closely with that of thunder. A strong Syntony reaction has been observed, yet the cause of Xiangli Yao's Awakening remains unclear due to the inability to recover samples of the unknown metal substance. Analysis of test samples has revealed a consistent, flat Rabelle's Curve followed by a sharp ascent and stabilization. Therefore, Xiangli Yao is identified as a Mutant Resonator.

Overclock Diagnostic Report: Resonator Xiangli Yao's waveform graph shows elliptical fluctuations. The pattern of Time Domain is stable with no abnormal waveforms.
Resonant Criticality: High. Xiangli Yao's frequency displays high stability with minimal risk of Overclocking. Records indicate no history of Overclocking. Routine examinations are advised, with no current need for psychological counseling.

entries.name: Zhezhi Forte Examination Report
entries.content:
Forte Examination Report

Resonance Power: Enchanted Brush

Resonance Evaluation Report:
Evaluation Basis: [Resonance Assessment 1231-G]
The exact timing of Resonator Zhezhi's Awakening is unclear. Signs of "animation" appeared in her childhood drawings, and her Forte control improved alongside her painting skills.

Overclock Diagnostic Report:
Resonator Zhezhi's waveform graph shows a regular pattern with brief abnormal fluctuations. Long-term monitoring of her Time Domain indicates that the waveforms remain stable. Examination results are within normal parameters.
Resonant Criticality: Normal. However, Zhezhi's frequency displays low stability with a high risk of Overclocking.

Records indicate no history of Overclocking.

Routine examinations and psychological counseling are advised.

Resonator Zhezhi's Tacet Mark is located on the back of her right hand. Post-Awakening observations have not found any significant physical changes. Testing shows Zhezhi can "animate" her paintings, affecting observers' visual perception and judgment (effective on both living organisms and Tacet Discords).

"Animation" has two levels: Moderate: Causes slight movements in two-dimensional images. Severe: Simulates three-dimensional volumetric forms, lasting up to 30 minutes and 28 seconds, covering up to 274.5 square meters.

Both levels produce illusions, not actual objects. No stable interval detected.

No similar Resonance Spectrum Pattern identified, and the cause of Zhezhi's Awakening remains unclear. Additionally, analysis of test samples show a Rabelle's Curve with a noticeable periodic waveform. Therefore, Zhezhi is identified as a Congenital Resonator.

entries.name: Depths of Illusive Realm
entries.content: A mysterious gateway emerges in the Whining Aix's Mire, providing access to a realm known as Somnoire. Legend has it that it hosts the dreams of all beings in Solaris.

entries.name: Rectifier
entries.content:
Rectifier is one of the five weapon types in Wuthering Waves. They are floating devices used to channel a Resanator's energy.

They are made using Tacetite. (A substance that can permanently hold Remnant Energy. When modified, it becomes a potent energy weapon for Resonators, able to harm the Tacet Discord.)

They come in various shapes and designs.

entries.name: Public Security Bureau
entries.content:
The Public Security Bureau is in charge of the Patrollers, who act as the law enforcing authority of Jinzhou (and potentially the entirety of Huanglong).

Notable Members: 

Name: Yinlin, Role: Patroller, Secret Agent
Name: Chixia, Role: Junior Patroller

entries.name: Court of Savantae
entries.content:
The Court of Savantae was a research organization with various Laboratories.

"That Fractsidus Overseer has been really generous with his sponsorship... It would have taken us much longer to build this place without him." - Hologram of a Male Researcher.

Researchers from the Court of Savantae often visited Mt. Firmament to investigate the time fluctuations, despite the cost that it would have on their lifespans. While initially distrusted by the locals, they struck a deal to build Mianloong Chamber's defense mechanisms in return for having their research undisturbed.

entries.name: Fractsidus
entries.content:
The Fractsidus is an organization that aims to accelerate the next Lament - dubbed the "True Lament" - by resurrecting the Threnodians. They have caused attacks of various scales across the world.

One of their other goals is their desire to have Rover join their cause. This goal persisting through acts II through V (and more) of Huanglong I.

The Fractsidus' strongest belief is that, to attain the next level of human evolution, individuals must absorb Tacet Discords into themselves, engaging in a transformative struggle. They are infamous for using Masks of Constraint in order to suppress the body's natural rejection of merging with a Tacet Discord. A major side effect of these masks is the suppression of natural human emotions.

There are two known ranks within the Fractsidus. "Artificers", a lower rank and "Overseers", leaders of the Fractsidus.

They are deemed enemies of Jinzhou, courtesy of Jinhsi, due to their aggravated actions against the region.

Known Members:

Name: Phrolova, Position: Overseer.
Name: Scar,Position: Overseer.
Name: The Exellency,Position: Overseer In Mt. Firmament Sonoro Sphere.

entries.name: Ghost Hounds
entries.content:
The Ghost Hounds are a multinational mercenary group rooted in the New Federation's Lawless Zone, annexed from the gang known as "the Underdogs", both led by Calcharo. It was once infiltrated by Yinlin.

Known Members:

Name: Calcharo, Role: Leader and Founder.

entries.name: Lollo Logistics
entries.content: Lollo Logistics is an international delivery company whose slogan is "We Promise, We Deliver!". Their couriers don an iconic hamster-themed outfit.

entries.name: Midnight Rangers
entries.content:
The Midnight Rangers are the primary military force of the Jinzhou region and are tasked with protecting the said regionfrom external threats. Jiyan is one of the leading generals of the Midnight Rangers. The military branch is integral to Huanglong's defense strategy, deploying wherever the nation’s enemies pose a threat. They are under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of War.

Vanguard
The Vanguard is responsible for conducting offensive combat operations against Tacet Discords. They have stopped recruiting non-Resonators in recent years due to the advent of increasingly intense battles.

Rearguard
The Rearguard protect the city and conduct a number of non-combat roles such as logistics, transport, maintenance and medical care to support the Vanguard on the frontline.

Outriders
The Outriders operate independent from the main troopers, focusing on gathering vital information about enemy territories. Their mobility and combat prowess make them essential in navigating uncharted territories and uncovering potential threats.

Notable Personnel:

Name: Jiyan, Position: General.
Name: Yhan, Position: Simulation Training Instructor.
Name: Yangyang, Position: Outrider.
Name: Danjin, Position: Unknown.

entries.name: Moon-Chasing Festival
entries.content:
The Moon-Chasing Festival is one of Huanglong's traditional festivals that features various origin stories. On this special night, Jinzhou residents decorate trees with an extensive range of lanterns and admire the moon to celebrate their reunion.

The Fox and The Moon
The tale of "The Fox and the Moon" is the most popular origin story of the Moon-Chasing Festival. According to the story, Hsin, a merrymaker among the Sentinels, once teased another Sentinel with a night of chasing during celebration. This joyous scene, as they were silhouetted against the mid-autumn moonlight, gave rise to the term "Moon-Chasing."

Dual Moons
For the people of Jinzhou, the Lunite and Threnodians at the borders are linked: the phases of the moon signify the revival pattern of the Threnodian, with dual moons serving as a harbinger of disaster.

Moon-Chasing symbolizes a race against the moon, where Jinzhou must give everything to prevent the dormant Threnodian from awakening before the Lunite moon becomes full. Only one full moon remains of the two, casting its glow on Solaris-3. The Lunite stays the same, yet everything else changes.

To honor the soldiers and citizens who contributed to this challenging victory, a former Jinzhou Magistrate established the "Moon-Chasing Festival," held when the moon is fullest each year. As the dual moons wane to a single full moon, the "race against the Moon" now means a journey home, guided by the pristine moonglow.

The Moonlit Fair is a special feast held in Jinzhou on the evening of the Moon-Chasing Festival, featuring various stalls for visitors to explore.

People in Jinzhou often accompany their families or invite friends to enjoy the festive atmosphere together.

Activities
Moontree Lodge
In the days leading up to the Moon-Chasing Festival, Jinzhou residents visit Taoyuan Vale to write their wishes on paper tags.

These tags are then either hung on the branches or placed in the

"Moontree Lodge," under the wishing tree.

Word on the street is that wishes made this way will all come true in various ways. Perhaps an anonymous hero has been working tirelessly behind the scene?

Yumyum Haven
Yumyum Haven sells popular sweet desserts and recipes, including their signature item, the Plumpcake, at the Moon-Chasing Festival.

These round treats represent family unity and are enjoyed for a happy reunion and fulfilling life.

Jinzhou's famous Plumpcake recipe has been passed down for centuries. The kind vendor is eager to teach anyone how to make these delectable treats.

Fan Drawing Stall
Jinzhou residents are proud of their hometown's natural beauty.

Poets and artists create poems and paintings on fans, treasured by locals. During the Moonlit Fair, stall owners commission artists to adorn fans with intricate designs.

Moon Shooter
In Jinzhou, a traditional event has become a high-tech shooting challenge with mechanical targets. Every year, enthusiasts come together to compete for the best scores.

Thus Says the Moon
Decades ago, a renowned fortune-teller arrived in Jinzhou. When he left, he abandoned his career, leaving behind a letter and a fortune stick. Jinzhou residents now shake the cylinder of fortune sticks when inspired, interpreting the results on their own. This divination stall offers "Sentinel Fortune Sticks", and the messages written on these sticks are often related to the Sentinels. Seek the blessings of the Sentinel daily, and luck may come your way.

Fireworks Shop
In Jinzhou, festivals are celebrated with fireworks. Every household joins in, creating a festive atmosphere that stays with the people of Jinzhou for a long time. To ensure safety, the fireworks shop only sells small firecrackers. Fireworks have been placed on both sides of the streets for visitors to light during the Moonlit Fair. Improved for safety, they won't harm your hands but still provide a colorful display.

Lantern Riddles
One of the traditional events in Jinzhou. Among these literary-styled riddles that take effort to crack, you may spot some strange questions. The stall owner is assessing the difficulty of the lantern riddles. A gift will be given to participants who visit the stall and guess the riddles each day.

Plum Blossom Pole
To attract more Liondance enthusiasts, the Liondance Troupe has set up these Plum Blossom Poles for visitors to try. The Troupe always shows up for Jinzhou's festivities, spreading lucky greetings and good wishes.

Puppet Theater
The puppet shows are widely loved by children of Jinzhou. Puppeteers control marionettes with strings, bringing traditional drama to the stage. Shows available at the Puppet Theater are broad in both scope and content, often adopted from tales and ancient legends.

Hsin's Fortuity
Spin the roulette wheel prepared by the Pioneer Association and receive rewards based on the Moon phase indicated by the Fox. Most prizes are from Pioneer Association Products, with new arrivals coming to Huanglong soon. Visitors will receive a daily free chance to spin the wheel for a prize of their luck!

Swim, Gulpuff, Swim
A stall designed by the researchers at Huaxu Academy transforms people into Gulpuffs for a thrilling race on the water's surface. This way, participants help with the Academy's research while having fun. In celebration of the Moon-Chasing Festival, the researchers have adjusted the game's rules and added various prizes for the participants.

Loong Dance
In some parts of Huanglong, the Loong Dance is a grand finale during the Moonlit Fair, especially in regions with Loong-shaped Sentinels. A majestic Loong soars through the sky, accompanied by bursts of fireworks. This ritual signifies a wish for peace and prosperity in the upcoming year.

entries.name: Abyss Surges
entries.content: The Gauntlets pulsate with an uncontrollable force, emanating unspeakable anger from the depths of the unknown lake. As you don them, unleash your fury on helpless enemies. Feel its power surge through you.

entries.name: Ages of Harvest
entries.content: This is Jinhsi's broadblade. Each swing of the blade reveals the flow of time and the change of the stars The sword embodies all things, uniting them into one. Its gentle aura seems capable of dissolving the indestructible. whether it's millennia-old ice or the stagnation of time.

entries.name: Blazing Brilliance
entries.content: Changli's sword. Forged from the very essence and feathers of a legendary bird, this weapon blazes with an intensity that bathes the world in its luminous glow. With each fiery surge, it consumes all in its path, leaving nothing but ashes in its wake.

entries.name: Cosmic Ripples
entries.content: Take hold of the frozen Rectifier, a powerful tool imbued with the energy of the celestial lake. Let it lead you to ultimate knowledge and vanquish all obstacles in your path.

entries.name: Emerald of Genesis
entries.content: Pay heed: the frigid blade reveals an icy current that amalgamates into a whirlpool of thoughts. Use this powerful sequence to crush your enemies with ease using the Sword.

entries.name: Lustrous Razor
entries.content: Gaze upon this Broadblade, its sharp edges glistening in the frigid air. As you wield it, you feel the power coursing through like a frozen river.

entries.name: Rime-Draped Sprouts
entries.content: This is Zhezhi's rectifier. An artist's seal adorned with rimed sprouts. It is stamped on numerous paintings that capture mountains and ravines in expressive, mesmerizing strokes. The tender sprouts symbolize the perpetual blossoming of artistic marvels.

entries.name: Static Mist
entries.content: Grip the sleek frame and feel its cool surface as you aim down the sight. With a pull of the trigger, unleash a thick smoke barrage onto the battlefield with these powerful Pistols in your hands.

entries.name: Stringmaster
entries.content: Yinlin's rectifier. As the puppet palm unfurls, deadly strings are unleashed with a menacing hum. The air crackles with power, immobilizing any foes caught in its grasp. The rapid bolts of electricity leave unhealable scars on their victims.

entries.name: Verdant Summit
entries.content: Jiyan's broadblade. The ancient mountain stands tall, its peak reaching towards the sky. A river flows for thousands of years, forming the blade of a powerful weapon. As it is unsheathed, a powerful dragon's roar echoes through the heavens and earth, causing the sea to churn. This awe-inspiring weapon strikes fear in all who witness its might.

entries.name: Verity's Handle
entries.content: Xiangli Yao's guantlets. Crafted with the lost art from the Court of Savantae, these gauntlets are solid and unbreakable, despite their lightweight materials. They are no tools of violence or aggression, but instruments for unraveling puzzles and pursuing the truth.

entries.name: Amity Accord
entries.content: Gauntlet weapons. A weapon designed to commemorate the Midnight Rangers' comradeship. "Thin garments yield to icy moons, while armor withstands the chill of stars."

entries.name: Augment
entries.content: This Rectifier is a ceremonial weapon used by the Jinzhou Magistrate of Huanglong at the inauguration ceremony. The golden ginkgo leaf pattern represents that Huanglong should be like ginkgo, although it is left alone in the world, it is still prosperous and long-lasting.

entries.name: Autumntrace
entries.content: This Broadblade is a ceremonial weapon used by the Jinzhou Magistrate of the Huanglong province at the inauguration ceremony. The golden ginkgo leaf pattern represents that Huanglong should be like ginkgo, although it is left alone in the world, it is still prosperous and long-lasting.

entries.name: Broadblade#41
entries.content: Improved version of a mass-produced broadblade model developed in Huanglong. With its formidable performance and innovative technologies, this broadblade carries a weight only to be wielded by seasoned warriors.

entries.name: Cadenza
entries.content: An ascending crescendo. These pistols unleash bullets with the force of thunder, tearing through the heavens like a symphony of destruction.

entries.name: Celestial Spiral
entries.content:
A prototype weapon designed by the Black Shores for elite combatants.
These gauntlets take their name from the devastating might of a blazar — a galactic nucleus whose blinding radiance pierces the cosmos, shining unmistakably across billions of light years.

entries.name: Comet Flare
entries.content: The Rectifier born from the aerial phenomenon. The forger integrates the feelings of witnessing the alien stars into the weapon, making it look delicate and light, but it can be stable and constant, and it can be responsive.

entries.name: Commando of Conviction
entries.content: A weapon designed to commemorate the Midnight Rangers' courage. "A thousand echoes carry the war's tale, as spirits unite in resounding gorges of valor."

entries.name: Dauntless Evernight
entries.content: A weapon designed to commemorate the Midnight Rangers' preparedness. "Autumn fades in endless nights, ready blades gleam with silent might."

entries.name: Discord
entries.content: A descending adagio. This broadblade dominates the battlefield with the power of discordance. The curtain never falls on a masterpiece.

entries.name: Endless Collapse
entries.content:
A prototype weapon designed by the Black Shores for elite combatants.
This sword takes its name from the heart of a blazar — a galactic nucleus whose blinding radiance pierces the cosmos, shining unmistakably across billions of light years.

entries.name: Fusion Accretion
entries.content: A prototype weapon designed by the Black Shores for elite combatants. This rectifier takes its name from the devastating might of a blazar-a galactic nucleus whose blinding radiance pierces the cosmos, shining unmistakably across billions of light years.

entries.name: Gauntlets#21D
entries.content: Huaxu Academy has independently improved and developed the first set of highly practical high-performance Gauntlets based on the previous source energy weapons, representing the care and warmth of the Academy, stable and lasting.

entries.name: Helios Cleaver
entries.content: The Broadblade born from the aerial phenomenon. The blacksmith incorporates the feelings of witnessing the alien star into the weapon, making it look hollow and light, but it can exert the invincible gravity of the starfall.

entries.name: Hollow Mirage
entries.content: The Gauntlets born from the strange phenomenon in the sky. The blacksmith infused the feelings of witnessing the strange star into the weapon, making it look hollow and light, but it can exert a tremendous momentum while protecting the user.

entries.name: Jinzhou Keeper
entries.content: A weapon designed to commemorate the Midnight Rangers' vigilant protection for Jinzhou. "Cast your gaze towards the north, where the city's silhouette fades, its gates veiled by the tranquil rain."

entries.name: Lumingloss
entries.content: This Sword is a ceremonial weapon used by the Jinzhou Magistrate of Huanglong at the inauguration ceremony. The golden ginkgo leaf pattern represents that Huanglong should be like ginkgo, although it is left in the world, it is still prosperous and long-lasting.

entries.name: Lunar Cutter
entries.content: The Sword born from the aerial phenomenon. The forger integrates the feelings of witnessing the alien star into the weapon, making it look light and sharp, but it can exert the energy of breaking the sky and cutting iron like mud.

entries.name: Marcato
entries.content: A descending adagio. These gauntlets pulsate with the power of surging waves, shattering anything in their path like a deadly hymn.

entries.name: Novaburst
entries.content: Pistols born from the strange phenomena in the sky. The forger infused the weapon with the feelings from witnessing the strange star, making it look hollow and light, yet extremely stable, with the power of thunder when it fires.

entries.name: Overture
entries.content: An ascending crescendo. This enchanting sword effortlessly cuts through anything in its way, like a glorious prelude.

entries.name: Pistols#26
entries.content: The Huaxu Academy has independently improved and developed the first highly practical high-performance Pistols based on the previous source energy weapons, representing the Academy's meticulous research and pointing directly to the profound.

entries.name: Rectifier#25
entries.content: Improved version of a Rectifier prototype from the Huanglong next-gen mass production weaponry project. With surging power and highly purified lens, its sound is only played by the wise of steel-like will.

entries.name: Relativistic Jet
entries.content:
A prototype weapon designed by the Black Shores for elite combatants.
These pistols takes their name from the incessant course of destruction of a blazar — a galactic nucleus whose blinding radiance pierces the cosmos, shining unmistakably across billions of light years.

entries.name: Stonard
entries.content: These Gauntlets are ceremonial weapon used at the inauguration ceremony of the Huanglong Magistrate. The golden ginkgo leaf pattern represents that Huanglong should be like a ginkgo, although it is left alone in the world, it is still prosperous and long-lasting.

entries.name: Sword#18
entries.content: Improved version of a mass-produced sword model developed in Huanglong. With its sleek blade and minimalist design, this sword is exclusively crafted for the skilled hands of seasoned warriors.

entries.name: Thunderbolt
entries.content: These Pistols are ceremonial weapons used in the inauguration ceremony of the Jinzhou Magistrate of Huanglong. The golden ginkgo leaf pattern represents that Huanglong should be like the ginkgo, although it is left in the world, it is still thriving.

entries.name: Undying Flame
entries.content: A set of pistols. A weapon designed to commemorate the Midnight Rangers' dedication. "Let my body ablaze, flames dance to banish all evil's haze."

entries.name: Variation
entries.content: A descending adagio. This rectifier opens up an insightful window into the situation, changing the tune of the intense battle concerto.

entries.name: Waning Redshift
entries.content:
A prototype weapon designed by the Black Shores for elite combatants.
This broadblade takes its name from the fate of a blazar — a galactic nucleus whose blinding radiance pierces the cosmos, shining unmistakably across billions of light years.

entries.name: Beguiling Melody
entries.content: A Broadblade Forged from the scale of Jué, this weapon resembles a musical instrument more than a tool of destruction.

entries.name: Broadblade of Night
entries.content: May victory prevail the lasting night. In addition to the sworn oath of protection, this broadblade also carries the resolution of those fighting souls.

entries.name: Broadblade of Voyager
entries.content: The Broadblade provided by the Pioneer Association for the explorers is brightly colored, not easy to lose, hard in texture, and can cope with various extreme environments for a long time, and is very popular among the explorers.

entries.name: Gauntlets of Night

entries.name: Gauntlets of Voyager

entries.name: Broadblade
entries.content:
Broadblades are one of the five weapon types that resonators can use. They are typically larger and longer than normal swords.

They are made using Tacetite. (A substance that can permanently hold Remnant Energy. When modified, it becomes a potent energy weapon for Resonators, able to harm the Tacet Discord.)

They come in various shapes and designs.

entries.name: Sword
entries.content:
One of the five weapon types that Resanators can use.

They are made using Tacetite. (A substance that can permanently hold Remnant Energy. When modified, it becomes a potent energy weapon for Resonators, able to harm the Tacet Discord.)

They come in various shapes and designs.

entries.name: Gauntlet
entries.content:
Gauntlets are one of the five weapon variants that Resanators can use.

They are made using Tacetite. (A substance that can permanently hold Remnant Energy. When modified, it becomes a potent energy weapon for Resonators, able to harm the Tacet Discord.)

They come in various shapes and designs.

entries.name: Pistols

Pistols are one of the five weapon types that resonators can use.

They are made using Tacetite. (A substance that can permanently hold Remnant Energy. When modified, it becomes a potent energy weapon for Resonators, able to harm the Tacet Discord.)

They come in various shapes and designs.

entries.name: Thundering Tacet Core
entries.content: The core of Tempest Memphis. Like a miniature thunderstorm, the core radiates a dazzling light between the flashes.

entries.name: Angelica
entries.content:
A lone and tall herb. It seems that it can confront grave difficulties with a composed demeanor. In Jinzhou, it's affectionately known as the "'Cold Beauty".
This association sometimes sparks an intriguing comparison to a certain researcher from the Academy—yet, neither of them will comment on this.

entries.name: Azure Lizard
entries.content: Carnivorous reptiles, mainly living by waters or in wetlands. Their skin is covered with leathery scales. While their whole body is blue, musclar spines are found on their back. They favor wet, warm environments and small shrimp, crabs for diet.

entries.name: Belle Poppy
entries.content:
Belle Poppy was once the symbol of the Port City of Guixu. It nearly went extinct when Incinero Petals were rampant.
However, at the outskirts of the city ruins, Belle Poppy was found to bloom still at its home, having endured the disaster.

entries.name: Bittberry
entries.content: A fruit of bitter taste and a childhood nightmare of many Jinzhou people. Bittberry is often associated with phrases like "recall past bitterness, savor present sweetness" or "bitter food detoxifies the body".

entries.name: Black-Striped Frog
entries.content: A small frog often found on the banks of the rivers and lakes. Their habitat is often established on lush bushes. When it rains, they often come out to feed on snails and earthworms. Therefore, after rain, Black-Striped Frogs can often be seen crossing the roads in an attempt to return to the waterside.

entries.name: Bunnywort
entries.content: Common bladderwort in river crevices. An insectivorous plant that is not harmful to human. Its stamens secrete a unique fragrant substance that attracts insects.

entries.name: Caltrop
entries.content: The fruit of Caltrop is known as tropfruit. It is produced underwater, beneath the plant's dense leaves. To obtain the fruit, the whole plant must be picked and the leaf must be carefully removed.

entries.name: Chromeshell
entries.content:
Chromeshell is a pearl shell. Under illumination, its nacre will glow with a strange polychrome gloss.
When it ebbs, many Chromeshells will be left on beaches.

entries.name: Cliffrecluse
entries.content:
A blossom on cliffs, swaying to the blowing of breezes.
When the flowers swing in the currents, their light gestures always leave a strong impression.

entries.name: Climbing Fig
entries.content:
The fruit of climbing vines that thrive on the exterior walls of buildings, which is often used in desserts.
When Jinzhou people move to a new residence, it's a tradition to take a cutting from the vine growing at their old house and plant it near the new home.

entries.name: Coriolus
entries.content:
A special fungus associated with ancient trees. Its medicinal and curative properties have been recorded in numerous medical classics of Jinzhou.
An ancient specimen is preserved in the Academy, a living relic tracing back to the era when the towering Central Banyan in the Dim Forest was not so majestic.

entries.name: Dewvetch
entries.content:
A scarlet Dewvetch. Natural moisture often builds on its buds, thus it is called Dewvetch
It is a major nectariferous plant within Huanglong. Its honey has a natural, fresh fragrance, and it is refreshing and sweet to taste.

entries.name: Erodorchid
entries.content:
A plant that grows on the edges of Tacet Fields. It blooms even in the harsh environment.
As a saprophyte, it cannot support photosynthesis with its pale leaves, and only absorbs nutrition from decayed organisms. As it is often found in areas lacking vitality, it is named "Erodorchid" by Resonators who often travel around dangerous zones.

entries.name: Floramber
entries.content: Floramber is a crafting material resource. It is a green crystalline ore.

entries.name: Fluorite
entries.content: An ore bearing a likeness to the Sentinel's scale. Can be used to repair weapons.

entries.name: Gemberry
entries.content: A gem-like plant with scarlet, sweet, and juice fruit, perfect for immediate consumption or sauce making.

entries.name: Gloom Slough
entries.content:
Gloomslough is commonly found among the ruins of villages or cities, and is named for the glowing light that resembles a candle flame without the heat.
Gloom Cicada's diet is mainly fluorescent plants, and the sloughs they produce are left with the sedimented fluorescent matters from the insects' skin.

entries.name: Goldenback Frog
entries.content: A small frog often found on the banks of the rivers and lakes. A heterochrome species of Black-Striped Frog. Since it is relatively scarce and more vulnerable to enemies due to the color, some amphibian fans will catch Goldenback Frogs after rain and take them home as petes[sic].

entries.name: Green Pit Lizard
entries.content: Carnivorous reptiles, common lizards in grasslands, though occasional sightings in towns exist. They would hide themselves in parterres or plant trellis. However, as they are not poisonous, has a wide diet and a gentle temper, they are sometimes taken as pets by citizens.

entries.name: Honeysuckle
entries.content:
Honeysuckle is named after its characteristic of two flowers blooming from one stem.
Besides its use in tea drinks and medicines, it is also a favorite ornamental pot plant in Jinzhou.

entries.name: Indigoite
entries.content: A widely distributed mineral. Its unique, profound purple distinguishes itself from other minerals. Due to its fragility, it requires careful processing with specialized equipment.

entries.name: Iris
entries.content:
A plant native to Whining Aix's Mire. It symbolizes broken or concealed affection.
Affected by the continuous thundercloud weather of its locale, this Iris experiences a significantly shortened flowering period compared to its original species. A true pity, indeed.

entries.name: Lampylumen
entries.content: A translucent specialty mineral found in the Tiger's Maw Mine. Both the crystal produce and raw status of this mineral has a translucent azure shine. As a material, it has extra toughness and stability.

entries.name: Lanternberry
entries.content:
Lanternberry grows in caves. Its fruit emits fluorescence in the dark.
Before miners get down the mine in the Tiger's Maw, the family will tuck a lanternberry's fruit into the workers' pockets, in the hope that this will lead them safely home in the midst of darkness.

entries.name: Lemongrass
entries.content:
An aromatic plant native to the New Federation. It exudes a unique citrus fragrance.
The stems and leaves of Lemongrass can be used to extract essential oil, which is an ingredient for perfume, soap, or seasoning to add a flavor twist to foods.

entries.name: Loong's Pearl
entries.content: A blue tranquil flower, casting its gentle radiance amidst the shadows.

entries.name: Lotus Seeds
entries.content: An aquatic plant prized for its ornamental and practical value. Its seeds are renowned for their fragrance in Jinzhou.

entries.name: Noctemint
entries.content: If applied externally, Noctemint soothes inflammation and relieves itching; if brewed with tea, Noctemint refreshes the user's mind. It is a daily essential, especially for warriors from the Midnight Rangers stationed in the wild. Chewing a few leaves offers a refreshing sensation from tongue to brain, assisting warriors through the enduring night.

entries.name: Pavo Plum
entries.content: Berries resembling feather-like berries, the people of Hongzhen call them Linglong Hearts. They have an incredibly spicy taste and are said to be able to refresh the mind and enhance intelligence when consumed.

entries.name: Pearl Leaf
entries.content:
Common countryside plants.
Mushed Pearl Leaves can quickly stop bleeding when applied to wounds. Junzhou pharmacopeia records an instance in when a Green Rabbit gnawed Pearl Leaves to accelerate the healing of wounds.

entries.name: Pecok Flower
entries.content:
A vibrant flower, its sap commonly utilized as dye.
The flower mud of the Pecok Flower serves as a base for printing colors, known for its fragrant scent and water-resistant properties. Frequently employed to authenticate documents and seals.

entries.name: Perilla
entries.content:
Perilla is not impressive to the eye, but is known for its unique, rich aroma.
The adding of Perilla to a dish not only removes unpleasant odor, but also enhances the ingredient's freshness.

entries.name: Scarletthorn
entries.content: A specialty mineral with a shape of needle clusters. Sharp and tough. Mostly used in cutting metals or other crystals or making weapons.

entries.name: Silver-Banded Lizard
entries.content: Carnivorous reptiles, mainly living in stone crevices or caves and other dark places. Their skin is covered with leathery scales, and their body has black and white ring-shaped patterns alternately arranged. They most feed on earthworms, snails, and insects.

entries.name: Terraspawn Fungus
entries.content: A fungus that spreads across dark soil. Once the cap matures and darkens, it liquefies itself. Soil touched by this liquid becomes fertile ground for further mushroom growth, hence its name, Terraspawn Fungus.

entries.name: Umbragricus
entries.content: Legend has it that a traveler, who delighted in exploring mountains and rivers, stumbled upon this mushroom. Its shape, resembling a person sheltering from rain under an umbrella, inspired the traveler to name it "Umbragricus".

entries.name: Viola
entries.content:
The Exiles prefer Viola, a plant of great vitality. They cook the young shoots of Viola as a source of vegetable.
Experienced observers can determine the whereabouts of the Exiles by the distribution of Viola.

entries.name: Violet Coral
entries.content: Violet Coral, commonly found trapped in the shallow beaches, is always revitalized with the flow and withered with the ebb.

entries.name: Waterlamp
entries.content:
A fluorescent plant that grows by the riverbanks. They look like the lamps at the sides of the ships anchoring for the night, hence the name Waterlamp.
The white pith inside Waterlamp's stem is used as wick, while the fibre of the stem skin is used for knit weaving and paper making.

entries.name: Crownless
entries.content:
An Overlord Class Murmurin TD found outside Gorges of Spirits. Known to be bellicose, malevolent, and aggressive. Further observation is needed to better picture this creature. It looks like a white knight with wings and wields a giant spear.

The Crownless does not immediately engage its opponent at the beginning of the battle. Rather, it prefers to test the opponent's strengths and weaknesses. By taking hits, it will gradually figure out the opponent's attack pattern and begin to evade. Once it has fully engaged, most of its attacks can be parried with Counter-Attacks.
An Overlord Class Murmurin TD found outside Gorges of Spirit. Known to be bellicose, malevolent, and aggressive. Further observation is needed to better picture this creature. This enemy has higher RES to Havoc damage.
Crownless is a Whisperin Tacet Discord born outside Gorges of Spirits along with the eruption of the strange Tacet Field. A vast mixture of human frequencies is detected within its physical form. For instance, the exhilaration and thirst for victory, the fear and resentment for casualty... Humans' long-suppressed barbarism is reified in Crownless and antagonized against themselves.
This creature is a pawn dispatched by the enemy in disguise, as well as a harbinger of the scourge of war.

entries.name: Wintry Bell
entries.content:
A flower blooming on the high shores.
Legend has it that the Wintry Bell does not really wither. When the ancient bells born by the giant Turtoise in Gorges of Spirits resonate, they will rise again from the ice and snow.

entries.name: Base Fluid
entries.content: It is widely used as a base liquid in many preparations.

entries.name: Basic Energy Core
entries.content: Purified liquid energy extracted from Tacetite, its purity increasing with higher ratings. When injected into a weapon, it offers a corresponding bonus.

entries.name: Basic Resonance Potion
entries.content: A potion that can greatly enhance the user's frequency perception ability. Collaborating with professional nutritionists, this potion is more beneficial to both physical and mental well-being compared to many healthcare products on the market. This potion enjoys a high reputation among Resonators, with many voices urging its manufacturer to explore a variety of flavors.

entries.name: Basic Sealed Tube
entries.content: A cylindrical storage that contains simplified frequency cluster. To activate it, users must rotate the cipher wheel to the correct position. Resonators can then extract its data using their Terminal, employing it to optimize the performance of the absorbed Echoes.

entries.name: Cadence Seed
entries.content: An unusual substance resembling the shape of a plant seed. If you listen carefully, you can feel a pulse-like rhythm. However, in fact, this substance is not alive, and its structure is pretty similar to that of the Tacet Core of a Howler.

entries.name: Crude Ring
entries.content: A crude ring that serves more as an identification than for practical use. It is used to display one's commitment to sever ties with civilized society.

entries.name: Impure Phlogiston
entries.content: A crystal shaped like a solidified flame. Its unconventional appearance challenges Old Science. Typically, it contains a rather high level of impurities and thus requires specialized purification treatment for practical use.

entries.name: Inert Metallic Drip
entries.content: A fluid metallic drip whose activity has been greatly diminished. Its surface appears lackluster, covered with a dense layer of passivation film. However, under suitable temperatures, the residual Frequency Energy within it can still be utilized.

entries.name: Lento Helix
entries.content: A helix with soothing waveforms. Facing this remarkable substance, human beings finally realize what static vibration is about.

entries.name: LF Howler Core
entries.content: The Tacet Core of a feeble Howler. It is the remaining part of a Tacetite Bloom after it withers. Despite its astonishing accuracy in mimicry, it only ends one way—reducing to a mass of twisted Frequency Energy.

entries.name: LF Whisperin Core
entries.content: The Tacet Core of a feeble Whisperin. It takes the form of a broken star. Faint and deep frequencies are still lingering within the core, yet the messages they try to convey remain elusive to all.

entries.name: Mask of Constraint
entries.content: A mask worn by Fractsidus recruits. It seems to be used to suppress the rejection reaction induced by the integration of Tacet Discords. The side effect that comes with it is the suppression of the wearer's normal human emotions. Perhaps, that's one of the designer's purposes?

entries.name: Waveworn Residue 210
entries.content: A Waveworn residue featuring a double-layered spherical shell. However, the inner balance has been disturbed, causing the Remnant within the inner core to reduce to the Reverberation.

entries.name: Adagio Helix
entries.content: A helix with gentle waveforms. Researchers can extract and utilize the sealed Cadence Energy within it. However, it is worth mentioning that researchers cannot effectively analyze the content contained within this helix.

entries.name: Basic Ring
entries.content: A ring with bearable quality. Apart from helping the Exiles to recognize each other's identification, it also provides various functions such as basic communication, location services, and scanning. These features assist the Exiles to better survive in the wilderness.

entries.name: Cadence Bud
entries.content: An unusual substance resembling the shape of a plant bud. If you listen carefully, you can sense the pleasure of sprouting from the ground. However, it can never grow into a complete plant.

entries.name: Extracted Phlogiston
entries.content: A crystal shaped like a solidified candle flame. Its impurities are significantly reduced through a rough extraction and recrystallization process. This makes it simple even for those without expertise to distinguish between crystals of varying quality.

entries.name: Fluid Catalyst
entries.content: Catalytic fluids that can accelerate the onset of action of all types of potions.

entries.name: Fluid Stabilizer
entries.content: Stabilizing fluids that improve the reliability of all types of potions.

entries.name: Mask of Erosion
entries.content: A mask worn by Fractsidus active members. Due to long-term use, its ability to stabilize frequency has been greatly mitigated. One can clearly feel the torment of being drowning[sic] in negative emotions from the mask.

entries.name: Medium Energy Core
entries.content: A supplement storing a small amount of Tacetite Energy. It can be used to recharge the core modules of Tacetite Weapons. Routine preventative maintenance of weapons is advised for all Resonators, or they may find themselves caught off guard in the case of an emergency.

entries.name: Medium Resonance Potion
entries.content: A potion that can greatly enhance the user's frequency perception ability. Collaborating with professional nutritionists, this potion is more beneficial to both physical and mental well-being compared to many healthcare products on the market. This potion enjoys a high reputation among Resonators, with many voices urging its manufacturer to explore a variety of flavors.

entries.name: Medium Sealed Tube
entries.content: A cylindrical storage that contains simplified frequency cluster. To activate it, users must rotate the cipher wheel to the correct position. Resonators can then extract its data using their Terminal, employing it to optimize the performance of the absorbed Echoes.

entries.name: Medium Tuner
entries.content: Adjust Echoes' frequencies, removes any noise, and unleash their true potential.

entries.name: MF Howler Core
entries.content: The Tacet Core of a common Howler. After the Tacetite Bloom withers, a certain amount of Frequency Energy remains. Similar to the natural cycle of life, this frequency can probably serve as the sustenance for newcomers.

entries.name: MF Whisperin Core
entries.content: The Tacet Core of a common Whisperin. It takes the form of a clear and complete star. Its Frequency Energy aligns with the hearing range of normal people. Yet, the question remains: what's the intention behind this imitation?

entries.name: Reactive Metallic Drip
entries.content: A fluid metallic drip whose activity has been partially retained. Its surface presents a luster similar to that of Tacetites. As it is quite reactive, it needs to be stored properly upon collection to prevent any loss of Frequency Energy.

entries.name: Shell Credit
entries.content: In the ancient past, the ancestors of Huanglong utilized seashells as currency, Though the manufacturing techniques have evolved over time, the shell-like appearance of this currency has endured. "As a witness, it preserves the history of our people."

entries.name: Waveworn Residue 226
entries.content: A Waveworn residue featuring a double-layered spherical shell. It is not in a state of decline. By selecting an appropriate absorber, users may still have the chance to extract Remnant Energy.

entries.name: Waveband
entries.content:
A Resonator's Forte is composed of countless Wavebands. When these Wavebands form a complete Resonance Chain, the Resonator can unleash their full power.

Resonators have a maximum of 6 Sequence Nodes, in what is called a Resonance Chain.

entries.name: Advanced Energy Core
entries.content: A supplement storing a small amount of Tacetite Energy. It can be used in the core modules of Tacetite Weapons to increase power output. WEapons are the allies of Resonators and Tacetites serve as their food. Only by nourischind weapons well can they be handier and more powerful in battles.

entries.name: Advanced Resonance Potion
entries.content: A potion that can greatly enhance the user's frequency perception ability. Collaborating with professional nutritionists, this potion is more beneficial to both physical and mental well-being compared to many healthcare products on the market. This potion enjoys a high reputation among Resonators, with many voices urging its manufacturer to explore a variety of flavors.

entries.name: Advanced Sealed Tube
entries.content: A cylindrical storage that contains simplified frequency cluster. To activate it, users must rotate the cipher wheel to the correct position. Resonators can then extract its data using their Terminal, employing it to optimize the performance of the absorbed Echoes.

entries.name: Advanced Tuner
entries.content: Adjust Echoes' frequencies, removes any noise, and unleash their true potential.

entries.name: Andante Helix
entries.content: A helix with graceful waveforms, like a melodious song composed by nature. Instead of being studied by scientists, it might in essence be a subject best explored by researchers of aesthetics.

entries.name: Cadence Leaf
entries.content: An unusual substance resembling the shape of a new leaf. If you listen carefully, you can hear the faint rustle of it bathing in sunlight and sucking dew. In fact, it is able to absorb the wandering Frequency Energy from the environment.

entries.name: Crystal Solvent
entries.content: A necessary solvent for Resonators. It not only helps stabilize themselves but also enhances the numerical level of Waveplates.

entries.name: Dreamless Feather
entries.content: Emerging from the abyss with aspirations of ruling the land and the beings in Jinzhou, it now lies extinguished in the shadows, leaving behind only this feather.

entries.name: Elegy Tacet Core
entries.content: The Tacet Core of Mourning Aix, singing a never-ending elegy. Those who touch the Tacet Core will be overwhelmed by a great sense of loneliness and loss and will unconsciously shed tears. But this is not empathy, perhaps just a kind of emotional hypersensitivity.

entries.name: Gilded Ginkgo
entries.content:
A beautiful jade has been carved into the shape of a ginkgo leaf.

Used to increase the Syntony Level of Golden Eternal weapons.

The series includes: Autumntrace, Stonard, Lumingloss, Thunderbolt, and Augment.

entries.name: Gold-Dissolving Feather
entries.content: Gold-Dissolving Feather is a Resonator Ascension Material obtainable from Impermanence Heron.

entries.name: Group Abomination Tacet Core
entries.content: Group Abomination Tacet Core is a Resonator Ascension Material obtainable from Mech Abomination.

entries.name: HF Howler Core
entries.content: The Tacet Core of a powerful Howler. The fierce and untamed Frequency Energy continues to reverberate within it. Evolution is all about adapting to the environment. Who will emerge victorious from the ordeal of the devastating Waveworm Phenomenon?

entries.name: HF Whisperin Core
entries.content: The Tacet Core of a powerful Whisperin. It takes the form of a star with sharp ridges along its outline—like an embodiment of its shrill Frequency Energy. Perhaps, its personification has already led to the Uncanny Valley effect.

entries.name: Hidden Thunder Tacet Core
entries.content: The core of Tempest Mephis. Like a miniature thundercloud, the rumbling thunder spreads from the Tacet Core, causing the surroundings to quiver in its wake.

entries.name: Improved Ring
entries.content: An improved Ring, exclusive to a selected few. This ring stores a large amount of wilderness survival information. Certain entries detailing rare plants and special minerals hold academic significance compared to papers written by the Academy.

entries.name: Lollo Stamp
entries.content:
"Thank you for being a Lollo Helper!
To express our gratitude, we'd love to present you with a Lollo Stamp. You can use it to exchange for your Lollo Helper special delivery at the designated Lollo Logistics stations."

entries.name: Mask of Distortion
entries.content: A mask worn by Fractsidus veterans. The original owner has now had no turning back on the road of Overclocking. Would they have chosen to wear this mask if they had foreseen all the torment and suffering that lay ahead?

entries.name: Monument Bell
entries.content: The ancient bell carried on the back of the Bell-Borne Geochelone. When the bell rings, the awakened past will leave a new mark in this era.

entries.name: Oscillated Coral
entries.content: The ripples of the waves converge into the sprouts of desire. "That is the echo of your call."

entries.name: Pioneer Association Advanced Supply
entries.content: The special supply pack issued by the Store. It is delivered to the customer by Lollo Logistics. Open to claim rich supplies.

entries.name: Pioneer Podcast Weapon Chest
entries.content: It contains the powerful weapon selected by the Pioneer Association for its explorers.

entries.name: Polarized Metallic Drip
entries.content: A fluid metallic drip with high activity. Its surface presents an amazing luster. This polarized matter only forms under extremely strict conditions, and the scientific world has yet to fully figure out its transformation patter.

entries.name: Rage Tacet Core
entries.content: The Tacet Core of Inferno Rider, surrounded by the never-ending fire of rage. The raging flames, fueled by the supreme clamor, vow to burn everything to ashes.

entries.name: Refined Phlogiston
entries.content: A crystal shaped like a solidified firework. After repeated purification, it is almost free of impurities. Its eye-catching and magnificent appearance not only holds practical utility but also elevates its collectible value.

entries.name: Roaring Rock Fist
entries.content: The rock shell covering the arm of Feilian Beringal, named for the thunderous roar of Feilian's heavy punch.

entries.name: Sentinel's Dagger
entries.content: A ritual vessel gifted by Sentinel Jué. Legend holds that upon the Lament's arrival in Jinzhou, time became entangled, with no more clear line between mornings and nights. The Magistrate used the Sentinel's dagger as the gnomon of the sundial to determine the date and time.

entries.name: Sound-Keeping Tacet Core
entries.content: The Tacet Core of Lampylumen Myriad, freezing the humming whispers. The surrounding sounds will be captured by the Tacet Core and turned into a cold absolute echo.

entries.name: Standard Weapon Mold
entries.content: A rare crafting material with extremely high plasticity. Can be used for the manufacture of various weapons.

entries.name: Strife Tacet Core
entries.content: The core of Crownless's clone. Only more strife and sacrifice can mend the cracks and voids within this Tacet Core.

entries.name: Strong Fluid Catalyst
entries.content: Powerful catalytic fluids that can significantly accelerate the onset of action of all types of potions.

entries.name: Strong Fluid Stabilizer
entries.content: Strong stabilizing fluids that significantly improve the reliability of all types of potions.

entries.name: Unending Destruction
entries.content: The card in Scar's hand with the mark of a black sheep. The flame attached to it seems to never extinguish. That flame will burn forever with Scar's never-ending desire for destruction.

entries.name: Waveplate
entries.content: Data values reflecting the real-time status of the Resonator. When the Resonator is active, the Waveplate gradually decrease. Once it reaches a critical level, the Resonator's mobility becomes restricted.

entries.name: Waveworn Residue 235
entries.content: A Waveworn residue featuring a double-layered spherical shell. It maintains a delicate balance. When it is highly concentrated in a centrifuge, it produces products that have various applications.

entries.name: Afterglow Coral
entries.content: The ripples of the waves converge into the branches of hope. "That is the proof of your encounter."

entries.name: Astrite
entries.content:
Echoes from distant planets have found their way here from the vast expanse of the universe. In the starry night, the symphony of civilizations from untold light-years away resonates.

"The precious remnants of the civilization reverberate within... Perhaps they hold infinite possibilities."

entries.name: Cadence Blossom
entries.content: An unusual substance resembling the shape of a blossom. If you listen carefully, you can hear the petals unfolding. At the end of the silent time, a blossom of Cadence finally bursts into bloom.

entries.name: FF Howler Core
entries.content: The Tacet Core of a special Howler. It takes the form of a seed emerging from a withered Tacetite Bloom. Life is brimming with endless possibilities. This core, akin to the seed of life, also contains infinite possibilities.

entries.name: FF Whisperin Core
entries.content: The Tacet Core of a special Whisperin. It takes the form of an intricate star, bearing both recognizable and unfamiliar Frequency Energy. It seems that humans only know the tip of the iceberg of themselves.

entries.name: Flame Feather Pendant
entries.content:
Through relentless practice, the most brilliant flames born of Forte are condensed into a flame feather nestled in your palm. Radiating a warmth akin to the touch of its creator, it shields the carrier from the harm of Flame Manipulation. This gift is reserved solely for the most significant individual.

A flame feather warm to the touch, bestowed by Changli. It symbolizes a cherished sentiment.

entries.name: Flawless Phlogiston
entries.content: A crystal shaped like a raging flame, known for its impeccable purity. As a result, some Resonators don't want to use these crystals solely for enhancement, instead opting to entrust professional craftsmen to process them into unique accessories.

entries.name: Heterized Metallic Drip
entries.content: A special fluid metallic drip which can barely form naturally. It maintains a perpetual flow on its surface. Microscopic examinations of a few samples have revealed its intricate inner structure, resembling more of a living organism than an inorganic substance.

entries.name: Lunite
entries.content:
The moon has long been shattered by the Waveworn Phenomenon. What we observe is nothing but the past's mirage.

Within the changing Lunite lies a treasure known as truth... Perhaps it reveals everything about the past and the future.

entries.name: Malleable Elite Class Echoes
entries.content: The echoes within the rift are hard to discern.

entries.name: Mangosteen
entries.content: An ordinary fruit that somehow bears a striking resemblance to the old model of Tacetite Grenade. This is not an indigenous species, as its growth conditions don't agree with the climate of Jinzhou. It's imported by water via the Gunchao Port located in the South.

entries.name: Mask of Insanity
entries.content: A very peculiar Fractsidus mask. It would be nearly impossible for a normal person to imagine the mental state of its owner. Judging from the residual frequency on the mask, one can perceive that the owner's emotions have become severely distorted, generating frequencies that resemble Tacet Discords.

entries.name: Mysterious Code
entries.content: The metal scrolls with mysterious symbols seem to be able to create some kind of connection with Rover.

entries.name: Palace Lantern
entries.content:
Perfect for holding in one's hand, this small and exquisite lantern is usually given out as souvenirs during the festival.

A common souvenir of the Moon-Chasing Festival that can be exchanged for exclusive rewards.

entries.name: Pioneer Association Premium Supply
entries.content: The special supply pack issued by the Store. It is delivered to the customer by Lollo Logistics. Open to claim rich supplies.

entries.name: Premium Energy Core
entries.content: A supplement storing high-density Tacetite Energy, fully capable of powering most Tacetite Weapons. Experienced Resonators often preassemble and preheat this supplement to prevent weapon malfunctions during intense battles.

entries.name: Premium Resonance Potion
entries.content: A potion that can greatly enhance the user's frequency perception ability. Collaborating with professional nutritionists, this potion is more beneficial to both physical and mental well-being compared to many healthcare products on the market. This potion enjoys a high reputation among Resonators, with many voices urging its manufacturer to explore a variety of flavors.

entries.name: Premium Sealed Tube
entries.content: A cylindrical storage that contains simplified frequency cluster. To activate it, users must rotate the cipher wheel to the correct position. Resonators can then extract its data using their Terminal, employing it to optimize the performance of the absorbed Echoes.

entries.name: Premium Tuner
entries.content: Adjust Echoes' frequencies, removes any noise, and unleash their true potential.

entries.name: Presto Helix
entries.content: A helix with intense waveforms. Researchers are greatly captivated by the perfect harmony of movement and stillness it displays. However, to this day, no one knows how this harmony is formed.

entries.name: Sonance Casket
entries.content: The Sonance Casket is a product of the natural decay and collapse of the Sonoro Sphere, containing the unlost past. Since the Sonoro Sphere is an important source of information for humans to understand the history of the Lament and the evolution of the civilization, the Sonance Casket, as a "fragment" and "condensation" of the Sonoro Sphere, is considered to have a high archaeological value and is regarded as an "antique" by people.

entries.name: Sugar Pearl
entries.content: A sweet oral vaccine, reminiscent of candy for children in Jinzhou, symbolizes their triumph over the epidemic.

entries.name: Tailored Ring
entries.content: A ring made of special material using unique techniques. Its owner must boast a legendary experience. Much of the information stored within it is encrypted and challenging to decipher for details.

entries.name: Waveworn Residue 239
entries.content: A Waveworn residue featuring a double-layered spherical shell. It is known for its astonishing balance. Due to its indispensable role in many high-tech fields, it is subject to the most stringent trade restrictions.

entries.name: Windchimer
entries.content: An ingenious gadget that captures sounds and transforms them into energy. It can be used in tuning. It is said to be of great interests to some collectors, who'd provide resources in exchange for them.

entries.name: Impermanence Heron
entries.content:
Herons are capable of consuming Cluster Prisms of any attribute.
An Overlord Class Howler TD showing up in Desorock Highland. It is known to be ferocious and highly aggresive. This enemy has higher RES to Havoc damage.
A giant avian creature that flies around Desorock Highland. Its three heads are respectively responsible for ingestion, offense, and guard.
“Foolish left, wicked right. Center head’s the greatest blight”, so would Jinzhou rhymes describe the heads.

entries.name: Inferno Rider
entries.content:
Inferno Rider would put its mount's flexibility into good use for charging and rapid slashing. Be careful with its blade attack. If it abandons its ride and gets close, Counter-Attack will be a good tool to fend it.
An Overlord Class Murmurin TD located in the Port City of Guixu. The only existing records noted a unique movement method of it among other Tacet Discords. This enemy has higher RES to Fusion damage.
A fiery "biker" born in the Port City of Guixu. It sets forth trials of courage with its unyielding flame for those who dare to trespass.
Throughout the long years, the truth of history gradually burns to ashes, and the knight who once sang boldly toward death becomes a harbinger of fear in the word of mouth among humanity.
"That is the rider who turns fear into fuel and brings calamity."
However, amidst the idle talk of the indigenous people in the Forsaken Home, another version quietly spreads.
"When you face that mighty rider, set aside your fear and respond with your utmost reverence. Prove to him your courage to be the last one standing."

It rides a flaming motorcycle.

entries.name: Lampylumen Myriad
entries.content:
This Tacet Discord relies on the ground cocoons to sustain its flight. When flying, it utilizes fluorescent light to locate its target and launch long-range attacks. Destroying the ground cocoons can make it fall to the ground. Attacking The Tacecrux at its tail, another weak spot, can also knock it down.
An Overlord Class Howler TD lying dormant under Tiger's Maw. It lures preys deep into the mist it hides in before capturing them. This enemy has higher RES to Glacio damage.
An ensnarer that slumbers in a freezing mine pit, obsessed with collecting and imitating sounds. It can imitate human speech through a vibrating hum.
Lampylumen Myriad uses sound as bait to lure its prey, which will be frozen in the deep cold. The loss of warmth and the illusion before dying will cause human beings to pour out their last words, which contain great emotional fluctuations.
For Lampylumen Myriad, this is the frequency of the supreme taste.

entries.name: Mech Abomination
entries.content:
A Staticoid TD that hides beneath an abandoned CSC facility, its physical form comprises a conglomerate of various objects. Threat level: Overlord Class. This enemy has higher RES to Electro damage.
Created in the CSC labs, this Mechanical TD has evolved by consuming machine wrecks. Upon discovering traces of human frequencies, it became fixated on achieving perfection and grew larger as it improved its composition. A haunting symbol of humanity's relentless pursuit of scientific advancement, its presence serves as a subtle reminder of our obsession and descent into madness.

entries.name: Mourning Aix
entries.content:
The Mourning Aix can "grab" the invader with "both hands" and deal a large amount of damage. Launching Counter-Attacks can force the creature to release its grip. Besides, similar to other Tacet Discords, the Tacecrux on its chest is its fatal weakness.
An Overlord Class Howler TD hovering over Whining Aix's Mire. It soars the skies while singing elegies, and attacks fiercely any enemy that comes close. This enemy has higher RES to Spectro damage.
A bird-of-prey-like animal that perches at the Whining Aix's Mire, with cries like a mournful song.
Legend has it that this bird once had a partner and that their chorus was a beautiful sound. Their names were not passed down, but their hymns were recorded and preserved by human beings.
Until one of them was deceased. The surviving one cried all day long, and the cries were so dismal it was called the Mourning Aix.
In the loss of a lover, the bird became oppressive and violent, allowing no one to step into its nest of lost love. It only lingers in the heavens while singing the eulogy, in pursuit of an illusion that is no longer there among the clouds.

entries.name: Tempest Mephis
entries.content:
Thundering Mephis will usually test its enemy through constant flash attacks at the beginning of the battle. These attacks can be repelled with Counter-Attacks. A successful Counter will immobilize it. Once it stops the testing, it will engage in close range attacks. At this stage, well-timed Counter-Attacks can abort its attacks.
An Overlord Class Murmurin TD hidden in Central Plains. It demonstrates combat abilities similar to those of a human. This enemy has higher RES to Electro damage.
A powerful TD that roams the Central Plains. With the aid of thunderstorms, it keeps devouring human sounds of protection. Regarded as a vanguard of the Crownless.

entries.name: Thundering Mephis
entries.content:
An Overlord Class Whisperin TD found in Desorock Highland. It demonstrates combat abilities similar to those of a human. This enemy has higher RES to Electro damage.
A powerful TD based in Desorock Highland with the power of thunder. It is considered one of the vanguards in the Threnodian’s army.

entries.name: Bell-Borne Geochelone
entries.content:
The shell of the Bell-Borne Geochelone seems indestructible. Only the ancient bell on its back has a few cracks present. Perhaps the key to defeating it lies beneath the bell.
A Calamity Class Howler TD lying dormant in Gorges of Spirit. Due to its permanent inactivity, records of its behaviors are scarce. This enemy has higher RES to Glacio damage.
A torpid snapping turtle in the frozen lake, carrying an ancient bell on its back.
Some researchers once tried to transcribe the inscriptions on the bell, but accidentally disturbed the gargantuan Chelonian’s dreams.
When it awakens, lasting toll will be echoing around the Gorges of Spirits.

entries.name: Dreamless
entries.content:
A Whisperin TD discovered in the Norfall Barrens, exhibiting more prominent characteristics of the human female form. There is a suspected link to Threnodian, surrounded by other TD sub-class aggregates. Due to its hazardous environment, there remains insufficient information and records, it has been classified as a Calamity Class. This enemy has higher RES to Havoc damage.
Along with the eerie Void Plenilune, this Whisperin TD appeared at the end of the Norfall Barrens.
Its very presence is an ominous reminder of the devastating war that once ravaged this land. Born from the residual energies of battle, it continues to evolve and has become the most feared weapon in the Threnodian's arsenal. With merciless destruction, it reawakens humanity's primal fear of warfare. And now, it greets its ruler, ready to unleash chaos upon the world.

entries.name: Feilian Beringal
entries.content:
An Overlord Class Howler TD in Dim Forest. With a giant size, it boasts the sovereign of this land. It is a giant white monkey thai wields a massive tree trunk as a weapon.

Feilian Beringal uses the pillar trapping it as its weapon. So the pillar is at the same time the threat and the weakness. Attacking the pillar may have unexpected result.
This enemy has higher RES to Aero damage.
A giant ape-like monster that resides at the towering banyan tree, guarding the apes’ territory from intrusion.
To avoid unexpected confrontation with it, the Midnight Rangers and the Huaxu Academy once collaborated in a special operation to fix the Feilian Beringal with a tracking bracelet, enabling the tracking of its movements within the forest.

entries.name: Jué
entries.content:
Jué, "Horn", is the Sentinel of Jinzhou and one of Huanglong's seven Sentinels, taking the form of a Loong (Dragon). A majestic deity with unquestionable power, omniscient of Jinzhou's past, present, and future. Jué, the wielder of time's flow, sees eons as mere moments and serves as the guiding force behind Jinzhou's civilization. In an instant, Jué can change the universe forever.

In ancient times, Jué descended on Mt. Firmament alongside a colossal vehicle, believed to be its hibernation pod. It sustained serious injuries in this event and lost the ability to restore time, instead only being able to stop and rewind it.

Jué had protected the people of Mt. Firmament against the Tacet Discord, and in turn, they worship it as their god, carving its likeness into the mountain.

Its power against the Tacet Discord brought upon Jinhsi, resurrected from her initial form as the Deceased Infant.

Jué reveals during Main Quest Thaw of Eons in Chapter I: Act VII - Thaw of Eons that Rover is its Arbiter and former master, the Rover of the past giving it the task of safeguarding the prosperity of Jinzhou.

entries.name: The Shepherd
entries.content:
Although they are unseen, they are mentioned by Scar through his personal interpretation of Qichi Village's dark story.

While the cause of the first Lament is unknown, it is implied that the shepherd was the conductor of that event.

entries.name: Phrolova
entries.content:
Phrolova is one of the Overseers of the Fractsidus.

She is a Resonator, her Tacet Mark being located on her upper left arm.

entries.name: Geshu Lin
entries.content:
He is the former general of the Midnight Rangers and the predecessor and rival of Jiyan.

He vanished during the Battle Beneath the Crescent, three years prior to the start of the story. He is believed to have Overclocked and died in battle, though his body was never found.

According to a storyteller's recount of the Battle Beneath the Crescent, Geshu Lin wielded a sword blazing with black flames, and had sacrificed his body to these flames in exchange for power before confronting Ovathrax. He was never seen again. Blamed for massive losses that occurred in the battle as a result of his final command for his soldiers to stand firm, he gained a notorious reputation in Huanglong.

He is a Resonator, and his Tacet Mark is on his neck. His weapon is described as a massive greatsword with black chains wrapped around the blade and hilt, with swirling patterns resembling rippling waves. Dark flames pulse from his weapon.

The Phantom projected of Geshu Lin showed him to differ greatly from his current successor, Jiyan, as he didn't believe the Retroact Rain would pose a serious threat, and he was determined to push forward in battle no matter how many lives it would cost.

entries.name: Scar
entries.content:
Scar is an Overseer of the Fractsidus.

His strong belief is that to attain the next level of human evolution, individuals must absorb the Tacet Discord into themselves, engaging in a transformative struggle. Scar perceives those who view the Lament as an apocalypse of boundless destruction as having a shallow understanding of the world. To him, the Tacet Discords brought forth by the Lament represent a self-regulating system of evolution, of accelerated change, as their physiologies rapidly shift to accommodate new living conditions. The Lament, by extension, is an era of rebirth, the era to wipe the slate clean, to start anew.

Scar sees the potential in Rover to absorb the recently revived Threnodian Crownless, making them a prime candidate for the organization. Scar’s mentorship involves guiding individuals through the process, believing the key to unlocking unique and twisted abilities in those who prove worthy lies in the Tacet Discords.

Scar appears to be a calm, yet opportunistic individual who is passionate about his ideals, actively seeking out individuals whom he deems worthy to join Fractsidus and undertake the transformative process with the Tacet Discord. Scar has a unique perspective on the world and vehemently opposes Huanglong’s efforts to suppress the Tacet Discord. His idea of a new world after harrowing turmoil reflects a twisted sense of evolution. He encourages individuals, especially Rover, whom he views as a kindred black lamb, doomed to stand out unfavorably from the rest, to join Fractsidus.

He is very dramatic, sinister, cunning, manipulative, and alluding when discussing his ideals, which can be shown when Rover and Scar share their first encounter. Scar also introduces himself as a "cruel and twisted maniac". He presents himself as very honest and genuine despite capturing Yangyang in an attempt to earn Rover's trust.

Scar tells the story of Qichi Village using a “fable” about a shepherd, a flock of lambs, and a black lamb as an analogy—indicating part of his playful and creative side. He also appears to value multiple perspectives, making him a very conscientious individual. Scar seems to value banter and games, as he didn’t want the Rover to cheat without looking for answers first. However, he then states that the people who succumbed to their grief (the lambs who sacrificed the black lamb) “had it coming”. Scar also claims that he self-identifies with the black lamb, being a rebel against the shepherd who breaks the rules.

As of now, Scar's backstory has not been revealed, however Yangyang does state that he could have a potential tie to Qichi Village through a strange Tacet Discord that is found while investigating the village after Scar leaves, calling out for their 'brother.' In addition, he seems to understand the story of Qichi Village extremely well.

Scar also has an unknown history with Jinzhou.

Scar is a tall and slim young man with spiky grey hair with red streaks and has numerous scars on his face, one on his right side of his face with another cutting vertically through his right eye, as well a horizontal on his left cheek. His right eye is red and his left eye is hazel-colored. He also has golden dangling earrings which can be described as upside-down fleur-de-lises. His attire consists of a majorly red and grey outfit. His pants are grey but fade to red towards the bottom, which is also flared. On top of his pants, he has grey garters that start from his hips and end a little below the knee. Apart from this, Scar also wears black gloves and black boots with red patches.

His smile is very wide and can be described as borderline psychopathic, matching his own description of himself.

entries.name: Abby
entries.content:
Abby (initially known as "Little One” before adopting its current name) is a sentient foreign Echo created by Lucia, who sealed it within the body of Rover into their now-awakened Tacet Mark at the beginning of the game.

Abby is a small, floating anthropomorphic creature, resembling a rabbit. Though it could possibly be a cabbit (cat-rabbit hybrid). Most of its body is covered by white fur, and it has two big ears, which appear almost feather/wing-like as they are designed as hovering/flight mechanisms. Abby has heterochromatic eyes, with the left eye being blue, while the right eye is orange. Its pupils look like Tacet Marks, while another mark of the same shape decorates Abby's forehead. Abby sports several adornments in the form of golden earrings, bracelets and a neck pendant.

 Abby is yet to be revealed. Several characters have hinted that Abby is some kind of an Echo, however, it is unlike most Echoes seen in Huanglong, as it is fully sentient, with its own personality, the ability to speak and the power to manifest for prolonged periods of time (however, this seems to consume Abby's energy quickly, and it often needs a prolonged rest or a large amount of food to gain back strength). Apparently, such Echoes also exist in other countries on Solaris-3, but more details about them are unknown.

However, one thing is clear - Abby's existence is strongly intertwined with that of Rover. In its dormant state, Abby was sealed within Rover's Tacet Mark on their hand (similar to a genie sealed within the magic lamp), and it is the entity that Baizhi discovered inside of Rover's body after their arrival in Jinzhou.
