The first member to define a Stellar Matrix noted that standards of observing and evaluating one are similar to the astronomical standards of Solaris-3.

entries.name: Black Shores Robots
entries.content:
These unique robots, found throughout the Black Shores, serve as the physical terminals of the Tethys System. Their construction and performance capabilities remain largely unknown, yet they possess direct access to the system, second only to its administrator. Within the Black Shores, these robots function both as assistants and tools in the daily activities of its members.

Each terminal has a distinct personality, and the study of these robots has advanced the field of cognitive psychology.

They are cube-shaped and often floating / hovering.

entries.name: Mutterflies / Aether Fins
entries.content:
Creatures made of pure remnant energy, 

Mutterflies look like golden ethereal butterflies.

Aether fins are blue ethereal fish. They are only present on Black Shores.

entries.name: Necrostar
entries.content:
A type of Stellar Matrix. Inside the Tethys System, a celestial body called Necrostar swallows the faulty data in its wake, a black hole where forsaken Matrices find their end.

Even the newfound science of Tacetite could not provide explanations for its fundamental nature, as all are subject to the gravity within it.

The Necrostar marks the beginning and the end of destruction. It also holds the key to salvation... Or perhaps, merely a lie.

Once known in ancient astronomy as a black hole. The Tethys system transforms data into stars and discarded data are cast into the necrostar.

entries.name: Eidoscope
entries.content:
The garden, nestled within the depths of the subterranean galaxy, serves as both the lens to observe its great expanse and the Shorekeeper's dwelling during her confinement by the Tethys System. It is said that the garden existed well before the founding of the Black Shores, functioning as the eye that gazes upon the stars. However, what the eye perceives may remain unknown to the heart. What truths lie behind these supreme concepts?

For the Shorekeeper it is where her true body used to resides in statis. It is her garden. It's where she assists Tethys' computational analysis in observing stars (laments). Ever since the necrostar was controlled and stabilised the Shorekeeper uses less computational power, allowing her true body to move. In fact she is no longer truly bound to Black Shores anymore, and remains there only out of duty.

entries.name: Starlight Blakebloom
entries.content:
A Blake Bloom that symbolizes the supreme authority of the Black Shores, donned by the leader of the organization.

"They have seen all the stars, journeying to the end of time and space and back. This gleaming star kept them company, a speck of blooming stardust illuminating the night sky and guiding their way home. Listen closely to hear echoes of their prescence."

entries.name: Bank of Life
entries.content: In the Black Shores underground resides a place where many types of flowers are grown and preserved.

entries.name: Black Shores: Underground
entries.content:
The upper and lower realms of the Black Shores are distinct yet interconnected, much like day and night. Beneath the sea's surface, the Black Shores' underground expanse stretches out as a city shrouded in perpetual darkness. Here, guided by their studies of the stars, Solaris' observers and modulators tirelessly search for the path to salvation...

This place holds records of every Lament across Solaris, past present and future. The planet's lament transforms into stars that fill the sky.

entries.name: The Tethys System
entries.content:
Also known as the Civilization Simulation Sand Table, the Tethys System is a supercomputer unique to the Black Shores. By inputting Lament frequency data-collected both manually and via beacon access-into the system, the Black Shores can issue Lament warnings for locations worldwide within a 24 to 48-hour time range. This capability is the cornerstone of the Black Shores' extensive collaborations with countries across the globe.

The results generated by the Tethys System are projected as a starry sky within the underground of the Black Shores, made possible by multiple Anchors and underground Data Hubs. This has earned the underground region the title "City of Eternal Night".

The Tethys System has no discernible energy source, physical
infrastructure, or processing core. Its coding language is extremely complex, and it is only known that its terminals take the form of various autonomous robots. In essence, the Tethys System is almost akin to a natural phenomenon, with an origin that remains entirely mysterious.

The Tethys System and by proxy the Shorekeeper records the exact details of every Lament, including the destruction, the names of every life lost and so on, using Sonoro Vision she can relive these moments or show them to other people.

It has been selectively containing Lament sources to drive its analysis of other occurences. The Tethys System needs a core unit capable of feeling emotion to function. The core was intended to be the Shorekeeper, however with the intervention of the Rover neither Lament Data nor the Shorekeeper herself are being used as the foundation anymore. Instead, the core computational unit has been replaced by a special frequency that shares similar properties as the Lament except is it more harmonious and mild compared to using Lament data.

entries.name: The end of wandering
entries.content:
The deepest parts of the Tethys system.

It is the shorekeeper's and Rover's shore, a private place only for them. It is tranquil.

"On the virtual shores, deep within the Tethys System, lies the ultimate destination of the Black Shores in a distant future.
The tides of fate bring the lost traveler to this place, where their journey finds their end.
Yet, the guardian of this final destination, like yourself, is but a remnant of that very future."

entries.name: Dwarf Cassowary
entries.content:
An endemic ratite-mimic TD inhabiting Mt. Firmament. Being flightless and non-hardy, it can only survive in areas below the mountain ridge.
Its name has two etymological origins within the Huanglong language family. One stems from a description from the
Hongzhen Chronicle: "This ratite-mmic TD is plump and seemingly lack of intelligence."
The other is originated from the local dialect. Locals use the word to describe creatures that "look dumb".

entries.name: Lava Larva
entries.content:
A larvae-mimic TD mainly inhabits areas beneath the tundra, near geothermal heat sources.
By absorbing geothermal energy, it can produce lava through a special organ to melt the frozen soil and dig tunnels extending in all directions. Lava Larva traces often lead to locations rich in geothermal energy.

entries.name: Clang Bang
entries.content: An immature humanoid TD. Small amounts of ice crystals are left on its body. It uses them to imitate the crisp sound of "clang bang" of ice colliding. It looks like an ice cube.

entries.name: Traffic Illuminator
entries.content:
This small enemy TD, fused with a traffic light, uses the common rule of "stop on red, go on green" to punish those who break traffic rules.

So, please remember to follow the traffic regulations!

entries.name: Fractsidus Gunmaster
entries.content:
Fractsidus' faithful cultists. Lacking in Forte yet bearing a strong yearning for power, they crossed forbidden scientific boundaries. Through the use of special mechanical components, their human bodies are amalgamated with TD limbs, thus their bodies mutate into powerful guns.
However, TD frequencies distort the cultists' mentality and corrode their bodies. They choose to bandage themselves to conceal their twisted face.

entries.name: Fractsidus Cannoneer
entries.content:
Fractsidus' faithful cultists.
Lacking in Forte yet bearing a strong yearning for power, they crossed forbidden scientific boundaries. Through the use of special mechanical components, their human bodies are amalgamated with TD limbs, thus their figures are unnaturally heightened to shoulder cannons.
However, TD frequencies distort the cultists' mentality and corrode their bodies. They choose to bandage themselves to conceal their twisted face.

entries.name: Hooscamp Clapperclaw
entries.content:
An anthropomorphic ape that appears in densely forested areas and seems to make a statement by stealing human items as trophies.
It's one of the more complex TDs with intelligent behavior in Huanglong territory so far, and will use sharp claws to guard its territory.

entries.name: Fractsidus Thruster
entries.content:
Fractsidus' faithful cultists. Lacking in Forte yet bearing a strong yearning for power, they crossed forbidden scientific boundaries. Through the use of special mechanical components, their human bodies are amalgamated with TD limbs, thus they became strong enough to wield gigantic hammers.
However, TD frequencies distort the cultists' mentality and corrode their bodies. They choose to bandage themselves to conceal their twisted face.

entries.name: Fusion Dreadmane
entries.content:
Wolf-like animals that roam the dry areas, known for their fury and bloodlust.
In order to fight against more powerful enemies, Annihilation Dreadmanes usually hunt in packs. Their operations are marked by the art of carnage.

entries.name: Hoartoise
entries.content: Tortoise-like amphibious creatures mostly often found along riverbanks. The shells on their backs are embedded with pieces of frost crystals. These creatures favor cold environments for naps. A warmer surrounding will wake up a Hoartoise, as well as kindle its hot-tempered nature.

entries.name: Diamondclaw
entries.content: Scorpion-like animals found mostly in dim areas. Their thick, hard crystal claws are deadly weapons against enemies.

entries.name: Hooscamp Flinger
entries.content:
Gibbon-like lifeforms primarily gathered in deep woodlands, Hoochiefs have the tendency to show off their supremacy by stealing human belongings.
They are TDs within Huanglong borders found to manifest relatively sophisticated cognitive abilities, capable of emulating humans in the use of certain rudimentary weapons and tools. In this case flinging rocks.

entries.name: Young Roseshroom
entries.content: Roseshrooms are fungus-like TDs inhabiting wetlands, whose caps are like the petals of a rose when fully bloomed, hence the name. While they are stationary, the core on their caps can gather and release light rays to attack passing creatures.

entries.name: Baby Viridblaze Saurian
entries.content:
Large amphibian-like creatures mostly found in forests. Their hard skins are found to emit heat.

Research has found that the tenacity of Viridblaze Saurian's skin
has a positive correlation to the beast's body temperature.

entries.name: Excarat
entries.content:
Mole-like animals with excellent burrowing capabilities. They are
able to excavate even concrete and steel.
With their complicated underground passage system, Excarats
can easily hide their traces and confuse their enemies.

entries.name: Sabyr Boar
entries.content:
Boar-like animals commonly found in forests, with a sensitive and irritable nature.
Sharp tusks are the solution to every problem a Sabyr Boar
encounters - it will always charge towards anything that intrudes its territory unrelentingly.
A Huanglong idiom also compares "Sabyr Boar's charge" to reckless people.

entries.name: Cruisewing
entries.content: Mayfly-like animals with a light body. They have wings like those of butterflies. Good at circling their enemies with flexible moves.

entries.name: Prisms
entries.content:
A mineral TD commonly found in mine veins.

As they come in different elements / attributes its rock body can be covered with either black and profound powers (for havoc), emitting a blinding brilliant glow (for spectro), having blazing magma under its body (for fusion), or crystals embedded in its body that reflect a cold light (for glacio).
Although its combat capability is relatively feeble, when it is destroyed, the energy it releases enhances the Tacet Discords in its vicinity.

entries.name: Chirpuff
entries.content:
Widely distributed riparian fish-like animals with a special algal flower structure on the crown of their skull and capable of drifting in the wind.
When threatened, Chirpuff will rapidly puff air and make a warning chirp.

entries.name: Gulpuff
entries.content:
Fish-like animals widely distributed in water bodies. Gulpuff often hides its body under the water surface and displays the lotus leaf-like structure over its head as a camouflage.
When threatened, these creatures swallow a large amount of water before inflating themselves and letting out gulp sounds to frighten the enemy.

entries.name: Tick Tack
entries.content:
A Common Class Whisperin TD widely distributed in the wild. It can wield a small amount of Havoc energy for attacks. This enemy has higher RES to Havoc damage.
An immature humanoid TD. Maybe imitating the clacking of teeth of human laughter, they always make sounds of "tick tack" whenever they encounter humans.

entries.name: Whiff Whaff
entries.content:
A Common Class Whisperin TD widely distributed in the wild. It can wield a small amount of Aero energy for attacks. This enemy has higher RES to Aero damage.
An immature humanoid TD, hovering in the air with the help of winds. It is able to alter its movement speed through the simple absorption of gases.
When it exhales air backwards and accelerates, it often emits a sound akin to "whoosh".

entries.name: Zig Zag
entries.content:
A Common Class Whisperin TD widely distributed in the wild. It can wield a small amount of Spectro energy for attacks. This enemy has higher RES to Spectro damage.
An immature humanoid TD that often emits a "zig zag” sound when they focus and release light rays.

entries.name: Snip Snap
entries.content:
A Common Class Whisperin TD widely distributed in the wild. It can wield a small amount of Fusion energy for attacks. This enemy has higher RES to Fusion damage.
An immature humanoid TD that exudes small amounts of magma, as though they are on the verge of boiling point.
When they battle, the magma on their body erupts with sparks and emits a crackling sound similar to "snip-snaping".

entries.name: Havoc Warrior
entries.content:
A Common Class WhisperinTD commonly found in the wild. Records show that a giant scythe is grown from its arm. This enemy has higher RES to Havoc damage.
A humanoid TD with scythes grown from its arms. It favors opponents less powerful, for only the weak are at the mercy of its trials and sentences.

entries.name: Fusion Warrior
entries.content:
A Common Class Whisperin TD commonly found in the wild. Records show that a sharp blade is grown from its arm. This enemy has higher RES to Fusion damage.
A humanoid TD with blades grown from its arms. Yearning for powerful opponents, it burns with a fighting spirit as surging as the blades at the end of its limbs.

entries.name: Aero Predator
entries.content:
A Common Class Whisperin TD that frequents the wilderness. Records show it is able to gather wind as boomerangs to toss and attack like humans. This enemy has higher RES to Aero damage.
A humanoid TD holding hunting gear, gathering storm as boomerangs.
Aero Predators’ thrusting of boomerangs is as unpredictable as vortex morphing around the seas. Taking the wastelands as its hunting ground, it takes delight in pursuit and prey.

entries.name: Glacio Predator
entries.content:
A Common Class WhisperinTD that frequents the wilderness. Records show it is able to gather Glacio energy to form a "projectile” and hurl it like humans. This enemy has a higher RES to Glacio damage.
A humanoid TD holding hunting gear, shaping frost as spears.
Glacio Predators’ throwing of spears is as accurate as snowflakes piercing through the air. Taking the wastelands as its hunting ground, it takes delight in pursuit and prey.

entries.name: Electro Predator
entries.content:
A Common Class Whisperin TD that frequents the wilderness. Records show it is capable of pulling bowstrings like humans and shooting lightning as arrows. This enemy has a higher RES to Electro damage.
A humanoid TD holding hunting gear, using lightning as arrows.
Electro Predators’ pulling of strings is as fast as thunders striking in the first springs. Taking the wastelands as its hunting ground, it takes delight in pursuit and prey.

entries.name: Fission Junrock
entries.content:
A Common Class Tranquilite TD inhabiting mountainous areas. Often overlooked due to its lava-like shape. A TD constructed with fragmented rocks. Commonly found in the company of Vanguard Junrock.
Different from the latter, Fission Junrock has a more active and unstable energy and easily explodes under impacts. Records show that it is sometimes used as a throwing weapon by other Tacet Discords.

entries.name: Vanguard Junrock
entries.content:
The Vanguard Junrock mainly uses melee attacks. Dodging its attacks causes it to rush into the ground and be temporarily immobilized.
A Common Class Tranquilite TD inhabiting mountainous areas. Often overlooked due to its rock-like appearance. A TD constructed with fragmented rocks. It has poor eyesight and a preference for rampaging.
The clinks and clacks of its rock skin colliding with other objects help Vanguard Junrock identify its circumstances.

entries.name: Lightcrusher
entries.content:
An Elite Class Howler TD. It is solitary and leaves behind luminous traces as it moves.

This enemy has higher RES to Spectro DMG.
An enormous feline-mimic TD, only sighted in Mt. Firmament in Huanglong.
According to the Hongzhen Chronicle, it is a solitary TD with four claws and a scaly back. It is called "Lightcrusher" because of the glowing tracks left in its wake.

entries.name: Lumiscale Construct
entries.content:
A mechanical construct guarding the ruins in Mt. Firmament. It takes direct orders from the Sentinel and functions as their guardian.

The enemy has higher RES to Glacio DMG.
Lumiscale Constructs are composed of Jué's defensive modules, commonly known as "Loong's Scales."
They are found throughout the Court of Savantae ruins in Mt. Firmament, tasked with eliminating intruders and potential threats to Jué.

entries.name: Glacio Dreadmane
entries.content:
This enemy has higher RES to Glacio DMG.
A wolf-mimic TD rampant in the snowland, gifted in stealth.
Glacio Dreadmanes utilize teamwork and mimicry as weapons against powerful opponents.

entries.name: Autopuppet Scout
entries.content:
An Elite Class Howler TD hiding in city ruins and often camouflaging itself with discarded fighting vehicles. This enemy has higher RES to Glacio damage.
The TD is a parasite of the Sentry Vehicle, camouflaging itself with a rusted and damaged armor shell. It serves as a "sentinel", monitoring all movements within the city and removing any potential threats.

entries.name: Hoochief Menace
entries.content:
An Elite Class Howler TD living nomadically across Dim Forest. Individuals live in packs. Records show that this TD is fractious and prone to stealing human objects. This enemy has higher RES to Aero damage.
Mimetic apes that appear in areas of dense forest seem to make a statement by stealing human objects as trophies.
The Hoochief Menace is particularly manic compared to other mimic apes, and its fists can unleash a blistering barrage of attacks.

entries.name: Fractsidus Executioner
entries.content:
Loyal believers in the Fractisidus lurking in the shadows. This enemy has higher RES to Havoc DMG.
Fractsidus' faithful cultists.
Lacking in Forte yet bearing a strong yearning for power, they crossed forbidden scientific boundaries. Through the use of special mechanical components, their human bodies are amalgamated with TD limbs, thus they obtain the ability to render themselves invisible.
However, TD frequencies distort the cultists’ mentality and corrode their bodies. Executioners are tasked with the removal of the Fractsidus members in breach of rules or gone out of control.

entries.name: Exile Technician
entries.content:
Technician members of the Exiles, commonly found in Exile Campgrounds. They are in charge of the repairing and making of weapons and equipment. This enemy has higher RES to Spectro DMG.
Female Resonators of Exile groups. As mechanics, Exile Technicians are in charge of the repair and making of weapons and other equipment.
Effective craftwork can significantly boost the group’s survival probability, while deadly weapons can guarantee wins for the group in battle for resources

entries.name: Exile Leader
entries.content:
Leaders of the Exiles, usually found in the Exile Campgrounds. They have more combat experience and skills than the average Exiles.
Leaders of Exile groups that oversee the allocation of resources and the arrangement of operations.
Most Exiles adhere to the law of survival of the fittest, thus the Exile Leaders are often chosen through numerous intense battles.

entries.name: Carapace
entries.content:
This enemy has higher RES to Aero DMG.
A TD living in discarded vehicles. It camouflages itself among ruins and foliage. Once disturbed, they exhibit a terrifying posture.

entries.name: Spearback
entries.content:
Spearback's front paws are covered with Tacetite, providing extremely strong physical durability.
An Elite Class Howler TD inhabiting the forest. It is often found on high alert. Ferocious black bear-like animals. Their head and shoulders are covered with arrow-shaped clusters of sharp Tacetite, like indestructible thorns.

entries.name: Hoochief Cyclone
entries.content:
Hoochiefs are usually found in groups, and their minors will join along in fights, but minors tend to flee and play dead after taking some damage. At this point, if there are adults nearby, younger individuals will be stopped from fleeing and inspired to rejoin the fight.
An Elite Class Howler TD living nomadically across Dim Forest. Individuals live in packs. Records show that this TD can bend the power of the wind to their will and attack with it. This enemy has higher RES to Aero DMG.
Gibbon-like lifeforms primarily gathered in deep woodlands, Hoochiefs have the tendency to show off their supremacy by stealing human belongings.
Unlike other Hoochiefs, Hoochief Cyclones can conjure air currents to not only launch long-range attacks but also restrict the movement of its targets.

entries.name: Havoc Dreadmane
entries.content:
Rupture Dreadmanes can cleverly dodge enemy attacks even before attacks are made, though this doesn't work every time. When endured with enough damage, Dreadmanes will enter an enraged state and can encourage its nearby companions with its howl. At the same time, its own attacks will generate additional Havoc Energy infused crystals for long-range attacks.
A Common Class Howler TD widely distributed in the wild. Individuals often take actions in groups and this particular TD is often found to lead the charges. This enemy has higher RES to Havoc DMG.
Wolf-like animals that roam the plains, known for their opportunistic nature.
In order to fight against more powerful enemies, Havoc Dreadmanes usually hunt in packs. Their operations are marked by the art of ambush.

entries.name: Roseshroom
entries.content:
The Tacetrite core on the top of mature Roseshroom is actually a taunt to fool its enemy. Its real weakness is the center of its Tacetite head. Attacking this position with pistols can disable it.
An Elite Class Tranquilite TD distributed in the wetlands. No records have documented voluntary moving attempts of this TD. This enemy has higher RES to Havoc DMG.
Roseshrooms are fungus-like creatures inhabiting wetlands, whose caps are like the petals of a rose when fully bloomed, hence the name.
While they are stationary, the core on their caps can gather and release light rays to attacked passing by creatures.

entries.name: Viridblaze Saurian
entries.content:
This enemy has higher RES to Fusion DMG.
Large amphibian-like creatures mostly found in forests. Their hard skins are found to emit heat.
Research has found that the tenacity of Viridblaze Saurian’s skin has a positive correlation to the beast’s body temperature.

entries.name: Chasm Guardian
entries.content:
The Tacecrux on the chest of the Chasm Guardian is its weak point. Attack it with pistols to deal high amounts of damage.
An Elite Class Murmurin TD with a humanoid appearance. With a colossal size like a fortification, it is usually spotted in the wild. This enemy has higher RES to Havoc DMG.
A tall TD guardian. Its figure resembles a huge boulder from the abyssal depths.
Despite its appearance of an indestructible fortification, the nature of Chasm Guardian is never to protect, but to crush any obstacle that blocks its advance.

entries.name: Rocksteady Guardian
entries.content:
The Tacecrux on the chest of the Rocksteady Guardian is its weak spot. Use pistols to deal satisfactory damage.
An Elite Class Murmurin TD with a humanoid appearance. With a colossal size like a monolith, it is usually spotted in the wild. This enemy has higher RES to Spectro DMG.
A tall TD guardian. Its figure resembles monolithic rocks from the mountains.
Despite its appearance of an indestructible fortification, the nature of Rocksteady Guardian is never to protect, but to crush any obstacle that blocks its advance.

entries.name: Tambourinist
entries.content:
Tambourinists can play a tune to create energy spheres of Havoc eEnergy to hinder players’ actions.
An Elite Class Murmurin TD often seen in the wild. Records show it looks like an instrumentalist with a tambourine in hand. This enemy has higher RES to Havoc DMG.
Humanoid TD that casts its power by playing the instrument. Imitating the human behaviour of playing bells and saying prayers, the words it emits are never blessing, but curses.

entries.name: Flautist
entries.content:
Though Flautist may be the first to appear in front of players, they will not attack directly. Instead, they always play a tune to turn their allies into rage. If a Flautist is under attack, it will try to flash and escape as soon as it catches the breath between attacks.
An Elite Class Murmurin TD often seen in the wild. Records show it looks like an instrumentalist with a flute in hand. This enemy has higher RES to Electro DMG.
A Humanoid TD that casts its power by playing the instrument. Imitating the human behavior of playing flutes to transmit messages, the melody it produces is only noisy and hoarse.

entries.name: Cyan-Feathered Heron
entries.content:
Herons regain all of its health after devouring Cluster Prisms, befor e entering an empowered state of the element of the Prism devoured. Under this state the Herons will launch more powerful attacks.
An Elite Class Howler TD found in forests and shores. Their aggressive nature is often shown in their stormy moves. This enemy has higher RES to Aero damage.
Heron-like animals found active in mountain forests and water edges. Though born with wide-spreading cyan wings, they only extend them and fly in roaring winds.

entries.name: Violet-Feathered Heron
entries.content:
Herons regain all of its health after devouring Cluster Prisms, befor e entering an empowered state of the element of the Prism devoured. Under this state the Herons will launch more powerful attacks.
An Elite Class Howler TD found in forests and shores. Their aggressive nature is often manifested in their thunderous actions. This enemy has higher RES to Electro damage.
Heron-like animals found active in mountain forests and water edges. Though born with wide-spreading purple wings, they only extend them and fly in furious thunderstorms.

entries.name: Stonewall Bracer
entries.content:
Stonewall Bracer will use its left hand to defend when being attacked. At this stage its left hand can be broken by repeated attacks, forcing it to change tactics. But once it begins to rage, the broken left hand will be recovered.
An Elite Class Tranquilite TD found in mountainous areas. They bear huge sizes and inhabit rocks. A TD constructed from rocks. Slow and clumsy, it possesses horrendous arm strength and prefers throwing stones to attack its enemies.

entries.name: Fallacy of No Return
entries.content:
It has higher RES to Spectro DMG.
It is the last line of defense built by the Tethys System, roaming between the boundaries of reality and data space.
The absolute safety and stability of this system must be preserved at all costs, even if it means exhausting the computing power of the stars, or seizing the power to modulate—
This is the core logic of the system, the foundation to continue the observation, and the unwavering protocol of Tethys.

entries.name: Hedgepuff
entries.content:
A unique Tacet Discord. This Gulpuff is born from anomalous data, possessing an enormous size and terrifying destructive
power.

entries.name: Shorekeeper Forte Examination Report
entries.content:
Resonance Evaluation Report

Resonance Power: Euphonic Chrysalis

[Extracted Archive Record - A.A1001]
Subject: Second Instance Recorder: ▇▇▇▇ Record Segment: A.A-000

The Second Instance (also known as the Shorekeeper) is composed entirely of high-purity Remnant Energy crystals. Its successful activation confirms the viability of ▇▇▇▇'s theory, which proposes the following: a. By modeling the "Blazar" module anchor, Remnant Energy can be attracted and condensed, resulting in the materialization of energy. b. Pre-loading informational data into the energy entity grants it cognitive abilities.

Unlike conventional resonance logic, the Second Instance (the Shorekeeper) can directly utilize Remnant Energy. When activated, the crystal-like marks on her chest emit a faint blue glow. Her frequency aligns with pure Remnant Energy but is affected by the selected module settings. Her ability cycle resembles stellar evolution. This is visually represented through phenomena such as butterfly-like nebula and domains that resemble star charts.

▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇ The subsequent status of the Second Instance will continue to be monitored by ▇▇.

Overclock Diagnostic Report
[Extracted Archive Record - A.A1001]
Subject: Second Instance Recorder: ▇▇▇▇ Record Segment: A.A-311

The ▇▇▇ test results for the Shorekeeper are generally within controllable parameters. However, the Remnant Energy within her has shown signs of dissipation multiple times, leading to excessive energy loss and crystal fragmentation. This may be attributed to the processing of Lament data via massive computation. Notably, the Shorekeeper has detected these issues and has attempted to mitigate the damage by replacing her damaged parts with new energy crystals. The string-like wave marks on her shoulders and calves are likely scars from this healing process.

The possibility of this issue recurring cannot be ruled out, which may require increased monitoring and more frequent replacement of the energy crystals. If the ▇▇▇ test results exceed controllable limits, alternative contingency plans may need to be implemented.

entries.name: Blazing Cutlass
entries.content: A unique Tacet Discord. This Fusion Warrior is born from anomalous data, possessing combat skills beyond imagination.

entries.name: Cyclone Swarm
entries.content:
Unique cluster of Tacet Discords.
A swarm of Cruisewings bunched together due to anomalous data, exhibiting a certain extent of teamwork.

While individual Cruisewings are weak, their combined forces can create a powerful storm.

This swarm possesses formidable combat abilities that should not be underestimated.

entries.name: Tambourine Duo
entries.content:
Unique group of Tacet Discords.
Two Tambourinists are fused together due to anomalous data, possessing frequencies of unimaginable intensity.

The sounds of their musical instruments are like the wails and resentments from the abyss-so haunting that merely hearing them might bring misfortune.

entries.name: Alptop Champion
entries.content:
A unique Tacet Discord. This Rocksteady Guardian is born from anomalous data, capable of smashing through multiple rock lavers with a single blow.

Despite its slow movement speed, its devastating force is more than enough to make up for it

entries.name: Stellar Symphony
entries.content: A rectifier bearing an energy core that simulates the lifecycle of stars—an infinite loop that originates from a singularity and ends in explosive demise. The celestial debris collides in thunderous rumbles, heralding the birth of a new star. It is white with a blue ethereal flame.

entries.name: Creamy Clouds
entries.content: A thick soup beloved by the Shorekeeper made with nothing fancy but the freshly caught seafood commonly found in coastal households. The secret is to add in heavy milk and reduce the soup slowly. It's little known that the soup was a result of the Shorekeeper's effort to recreate a soup that used to bring her so much comfort. She tried to replicate it to the best of her recollection, but through numerous attempts, she ended up with a recipe with her personal touch. The sweetness of the seafood blends well with a freshly toasted slice of bread. Its warmth soothes fatigue and soul... Maybe that's what that person meant by a "simple but certain" happiness.

entries.name: Hourglass of Cycle
entries.content:
Stars flicker in the eternal night beneath the Black Shores, where time flows without the rhythm of seasons. In this place untouched by time, Rover created a self-sustaining hourglass for the Shorekeeper.

An energy substance flows endlessly between its twin chambers, completing a cycle every 42 days. This number, both finite and boundless, marks the time the Tethys System requires for a full simulation and deduction cycle—from bloom to doom. During this 42-day interval set by Rover, the Shorekeeper finds brief yet comforting solace in her lifelong vigil as she waits for the day she's reunited with her one and only.

entries.name: We Are One
entries.content:
A record crafted from a substance infused with Remnant Energy, possessing near-infinite storage.

It holds every sound the Shorekeeper has ever gathered from this planet—storm and wind, the cries of birds, the songs of whales. It captures music spanning countless eras and vowel whispers from over 50 languages... Each sound is a testament to the marvel of existence, a trace of life, science, and the civilizations that once thrived.

The Shorekeeper preserved her duet with Rover at the end of this record. To her, this melody is proof of their existence. As long as the record endures and the sounds of this planet continue, the contents of this record will forever grow.

entries.name: Youhu's Poetry Collection
entries.content:
A booklet Youhu always carries to jot down her favorite poems and snippets of inspiration for her limericks.
They say to record all your ideas you never know when they'll come in handy. That's exactly what Youhu does every day, capturing every clever thought, whether for antique appraisals or an occasion that calls for a witty poem. It's her way of keeping her mind sharp.
But of course, this is her little secret, so let's keep it between us, hm?

entries.name: Youhu's Ice Mask
entries.content:
An ice mask conjured by Youhu's Forte. The design differs from the original, but the sly grin on the mask mirrors Youhu's own when she's scheming up some mischief.
Youhu often toys with this mask in her spare time, keeping it as a reminder of how she was nearly deceived when appraising the original antique early in her career.
Beyond serving as a cautionary symbol, it's also the perfect prop for giving people a good scare or pulling a fast one on those who catch her interest.

entries.name: The Ruyi Ring
entries.content:
A jade ring once cracked, now repaired by Youhu with her cryogenic Forte.
Once lost in the chaos of a fire, this family heirloom has finally found its way back to Youhu after an arduous search spanning miles. She still dreams of the old days—the gentle breeze from her mother's fan, the sound of her father brewing tea. When she wakes, she often finds the Ruyi ring clutched in her hand.
Ruyi, a symbol of peace and happiness, is believed to grant one's wishes. To Youhu, it's more than just an antique.

entries.name: Youhu Forte Examination Report
entries.content:
Resonance Evaluation Report

Resonance Power: Cryogenic Wonders

Evaluation Basis: [Resonance Assessment RA1013-G]

Resonator Youhu’s Awakening occurred three years prior, with early manifestations observed during childhood. The Awakening was accompanied by symptoms of hypothermia induced by prolonged exposure to low-temperature environments.

Youhu's Tacet Mark is located on her upper left arm. Snowflake patterns have been observed on the forearms. Temperature readings indicate these patterns are below 0°C. The texture remains largely unchanged, though a slight presence of micro-crystalline particles has been detected upon tactile examination.

Youhu demonstrates the ability to replicate antiques using ice, achieved through resonation with the frequencies of said objects. However, detailed data collection has been hindered by the subject's unpredictable and uncooperative nature.

Youhu's Resonance Spectrum closely aligns with that of the Ruyi Ring, indicating strong Syntony reactions.

Analysis of test samples has revealed a non-convergent Rabelle's Curve with a steep rise in its middle section. Therefore, Youhu is classified as a Mutant Resonator.

Overclock Diagnostic Report
The waveform graph for Resonator Youhu shows a non-periodic rectangular pulse fluctuation for once, with sustained peak values during specific time intervals before a gradual decease. These waveforms currently displays clear sinusoidal fluctuations. Both the upper and lower peak values are low.

Resonant Criticality: Relatively high. Resonator Youhu's frequency displays high stability with a low risk of Overclocking.

Regular physical check-ups are recommended, while psychological counseling is not currently necessary.

entries.name: Changli Forte Examination Report
entries.content:
Resonance Evaluation Report

Resonance Power: Eternal Blaze

Resonance Evaluation Report
Evaluation Basis: [Resonance Assessment 2326-G]
The precise timing of Resonator Changli's Awakening remains uncertain. Reports indicate that Resonator Changli displayed early signs of fire manipulation during her childhood, often struggling to control it. However, as Changli matured into adulthood, the frequency and stability of these manifestations notably improved.

Resonator Changli's Tacet Mark is situated on her lower chest. Post-Awakening examinations have identified specific alterations in her physical attributes. These include a gradual fading of hair color at the tips and feather-like burn marks on her left arm, emitting a fiery glow influenced by her Forte.

The Resonance Spectrum Pattern of Changli mirrors the characteristics of fire, displaying a robust Syntony reaction in testing. Despite the exact trigger for her Awakening remaining uncertain, no other sample with a Resonance Spectrum Pattern similarity exceeding 60% has been identified. Resonator Changli's Forte aligns closely with the mythical spirit bird from Huanglong folklore, possibly influenced by her early immersion in tales related to this legendary creature.

Resonator Changli possesses the unique ability to compress flames into delicate feather-shaped projectiles. Her Forte, once unleashed, has the power to create scorching fires of exceptional heat, capable of devastating a large area. A telltale sign that her Forte is active is the emergence of a lone fiery feather with an eye-like pattern on her forehead, which she describes as the "Mind's Eye."

Analysis of test samples has revealed a non-convergent Rabelle's Curve with a stable rise. Occasional fluctuations within normal range have been detected. Therefore, Changli is identified as a Natural Resonator.

Overclock Diagnostic Report
Resonator Changli's waveform graph shows elliptical fluctuations. The pattern of Time Domain is stable, with no abnormal waveform.
Resonant Criticality: High. Resonator Changli's frequency displays high stability, and the risk of Overclocking is minimal. Resonator Changli has a documented history of Overclocking.

Maximum recorded Overclocking rating: Negligible.

According to Changli's report, she experienced Overclocking during her childhood due to prolonged exposure to a hazardous environment. This caused her Forte to go into an explosive state multiple times for self-preservation or the protection of others, resulting in a permanent burn mark on her left arm.

However, as she grew up and gained more control over her Forte, the frequency fluctuation stabilized and the burn mark did not worsen. There may be irreversible physical damage from the Forte burst, which could potentially shorten Resonator Changli's lifespan.

Regular physical check-ups are recommended, while psychological counseling is not currently necessary.

entries.name: Camellya's Wooden Doll
entries.content:
An intricately carved wooden doll, shaped in Rover's likeness and crafted from the roots created by Camellya's Forte. It reflects her unique aesthetic.
Before their reunion in Jinzhou, Camellya had made countless attempts to sculpt the doll's face, each attempt leading to frustration as she could never quite perfect the final stroke.
Now, after all the vague attempts and disappointments, her vision has finally come to life. As she gazes upon her creation, she can't help but chuckle.

"So, this is what it was meant to be like," she thought. "Hehe, just as adorable as I imagined."

entries.name: Jinhsi Forte Examination Report
entries.content:
Resonance Evaluation Report

Resonance Power: Thawborn Renewal

Resonance Evaluation Report
Evaluation Basis: [Resonance Assessment 2100-G]
The exact timing of Resonator Jinhsi's Awakening remains unclear. Signs of her Awakening manifested early in her life, establishing a profound resonance with Sentinel Jué.

Positioned at the midpoint of her back, Jinhsi's Tacet Mark is a distinct feature. When activating her Resonance Ability, crystalline formations resembling Loong horns materialize above her head.

Through her unique gift, Jinhsi can manipulate light to create holographic projections mirroring Sentinel Jué, showcasing power comparable to the Sentinel's own abilities.

Observational data points towards the exceptional growth capacity of Jinhsi's Resonance Ability. The pinnacle of this ability hints at the remarkable prospect of revitalizing stagnant time.

Detailed analysis of Jinhsi's Resonance Spectrum Pattern has unveiled a striking resemblance to that of Sentinel Jué. Rigorous testing has uncovered strong Syntony reactions. Nevertheless, the precise trigger behind Jinhsi's Awakening remains enigmatic due to the Sentinel's special position.

Analysis of test samples has revealed a non-convergent Rabelle's Curve with a noticeable periodic waveform, which classifies Jinhsi as a Congenital Resonator.

Overclock Diagnostic Report
Resonator Jinhsi's waveform graph displays elliptical fluctuations. The pattern of Time Domain is stable with no abnormal waveform.
Resonant Criticality: Extremely high. Resonator Jinhsi's frequency displays high stability. It is almost certain that she bears no risk of Overclocking.

Resonator Jinhsi has no past record of Overclocking.

Routine examinations are recommended, while psychological counseling is currently deemed unnecessary.

entries.name: Lumi
entries.content:
She is a Lollo Logistics courier and an Electro Resonator.

From dense forests to vast wilderness, places where navigator of Lollo Logistics Lumi has traveled bear witness to her charming personality, like a shaft of sunlight. Born disciplined, she is now enjoying her daily tasks as a diligent courier, honoring her duty of punctual delivery.

entries.name: Red Spring
entries.content:
This is Camellya's signature sword. A camellia bud silently unfurls. As promised, she holds this infinite world in bloom in her palms, where fine crimson vines twine around her fingertips. The dull ache, like sand scratching against the heart, is proof of your fateful encounter.

A long thin sword, red vines climb across it. The center of the sword is white. The handle is circular and a small flower blooms from the center of it. The pommel is pointed and sharp, the blade is wavy and jagged, both of these parts are crystalline.

entries.name: Spectrum Bracelet
entries.content: A frequency spectrum-monitoring bracelet designed by the Black Shores, created at Camellya's strong insistence. Its design resembles a cherished gift from a bygone era, equipped with similar tracking features to keep the wearer's location and safety known from afar. Camellya understands that she is no longer the Lady Flora of old, nor does she wish to be. Gone are the days of shadowing the Rover, but so what? Both of them will do what makes them happy. For her, this is the sole anchor in an endless sea of meaninglessness.

entries.name: Camellia
entries.content: A flower dedicated to a certain person. Whether as a leader, a Modulator, or now as the Rover, the hero of Jinzhou, a guide… Camellya has never cared about their title or accompanying responsibilities. However, she knows she cannot, and indeed will not, let her own perspective on life color their judgment. So let this everlasting flower convey her feelings where mere words may fall short. "It only blooms for you, forever and always."

entries.name: Camellya Forte Examination Report
entries.content:
Resonance Evaluation Report

Resonance Power: Sanguine Blossom

Resonance Evaluation Report Evaluation Basis: [Resonance Assessment RA2 -G]
The exact timing of Resonator Camellya's Awakening is unclear due to her disorder. She has been capable of utilizing her Forte since Awakening. Resonator Camellya's Tacet Mark is located on her chest. Following her Awakening, her body has exhibited clear signs of vegetative somatization. Both her right arm and head show alterations, with the degree of change intensifying alongside frequency fluctuations. 

Camellya's Resonance Spectrum Pattern closely resembles that of a camellia flower, displaying a strong Syntony reaction. However, the cause of Camellya's Awakening remains unclear since no object that matches the changes in her Resonance Spectrum Pattern has been found.

The initial phase of Rabelle's Curve displays multiple irregular fluctuations. Once Rabelle's Curve surpasses criticality,▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇▇.

"This subject is suspected to be an Artificial Resonator. However, the current curve pattern doesn't match with any known samples, Therefore, this report is sealed for now."

Overclock Diagnostic Report
Resonator Camellya's waveform graph exhibits needle-like fluctuations. The Time Domain pattern reveals intense, chaotic activity, with an extremely high frequency. During testing, the Time Domain data displayed significant distortion, and the peak value remains indeterminable.

Resonant Criticality: Low. Resonator Camellya's frequency displays extremely low stability, with a high risk of Overclocking.

Resonator Camellya has a documented history of Overclocking. Maximum recorded Overclocking rating: High.

According to Camellya's report, Overclocking episodes occurred following her Awakening and were frequently associated with the recovery from ▇▇▇ disorder, as well as emotional fluctuations. In the later stages of Overclocking, her symptoms progressed to full-body vegetative somatization. This condition resulted in speech degradation, cognitive disorientation, and episodes of pain. The specific trigger for her current deterioration remains indeterminable.

Regular physical examinations are mandatory, and scheduled compulsory intervention is required given the minimal efficacy of psychological counseling.

entries.name: Somnoire
entries.content:
The Somnoire is a mysterious and relatively unknown realm in Solaris-3 that is related to dreams. It can only be entered through a gateway that only appears at certain locations, guarded by the Ebony and Ivory Gatekeeper, and inhabited by other entities.

According to the Ebony Gatekeeper, the realm was created by someone the Rover knew, though the Ivory Gatekeeper claims multiple people made it.

Little is known about the Somnoire other than its a realm that is claimed to have all the dreams, memories, and emotions of Solaris-3 converge onto it. This causes the realm to be considered bizarre and unnatural due to being made up of humans dreams and memories, which connects to both them and all living beings who have ever lived throughout history. Thus the Somnoire holds different "sections" made up of landscapes that may not make sense in general. The Ebony Gatekeeper states that the Somnoire records everything on Solaris-3 with the Rover being a crucial component to function properly, and that the Somnoire requires real memories and experience to form these different areas.

These areas can be entered through doors, where the more doors you open, the deeper one goes into the "dream". However, the areas may also be altered when dangerous intrusive beings such as Scar and Dreamless invade the realm, forming chaos that causes the realm to become more mismatched and allowing Tacet Discord to appear due to the Somnoire being similar to a Tacet Field. Intrusive beings like them may also cause interference in the Somnoire, which in turn mixes dreamscapes together. The result being that certain people may look at the same item/entity at the same time, yet each see something else in their perspective. These anomalies in Somnoire are considered disruptive to the usual laws and order of the realm's space.

Whenever one enters the Somnoire, they become an "Onlooker" and cannot bring anything with them. However, they may manifest objects or Echoes through recorded memories, or being given enhancement items known as Metaphors and Tokens from inhabitants such as the Gatekeepers or entities known as an Illusia. At the same time, the Onlooker may assume a different form as Rover does, who may appear as either themselves, or become a different Resonator with their skillset and abilities. The unique space of the Somnoire may also allow an Onlooker to enter another's dreams and potentially gain an aspect of them for assistance.

However, the Ivory Gatekeeper explains that only the Rover may enter the Somnoire and leave it at will, as nobody else may see the anomalies or the gateways produced by the Somnoire. Having control over both Gatekeepers and the Somnoire before the Rover wiped their memories and lost this knowledge. Although it is possible for other people to enter the realm under unique circumstances, that being, a part of their consciousness becoming trapped in the realm until one of the Gatekeepers releases them. During that time, the original dreamers are incapable of dreaming until then.

According to "Dorothy", an inhabitant of the Somnoire, time also functions differently within the realm. Claiming that memories of the inhabitants may stems not from the past, but from the future. This may be a possible due to the Somnoire recording all of Solaris-3's inhabitants memories and dreams across history, even from the future.

Another facet of the realm, as revealed by the Ebony Gatekeeper, is that the Somnoire is an artificial creation that is finite. Despite having tens of millions of gateways that lead to different realms, the amount that can be held is limited. As such, during periodic schedules, the Somnoire must delete countless dreams and memoires to save space through the usage of safety filters and the Ebony Gatekeeper. Though, while it is possible to create more space by expanding the realm into Solaris-3, the consequences are disastrous as they can cause various nightmares and Tacet Discords to manifest and enter the planet, causing untold devastation that endanger the entire world unless it is stopped.

It is also revealed that the entire realm was created for the possibility that a dream may hold the answer to deal with the Lament. Thus why all dreams are stored until they are reviewed and later deleted for the next dream.

The Somnoire is home to certain beings which include:

Illusia: The primary inhabitants are known as Illusias. They are described as virtual entities, a conglomeration of the countless consciousnesses within the Gate. They are stated by the Ebony Gatekeeper to be those who dream, though don't truly exist and have formed due to the gate that leads into the realm. They may give Tokens and other items to those who enter the realm.

Dreamers: Those who dream and thus are recorded by the Somnoire. Onlookers who enter may find themselves observe another person's dream, allowing them to gain the aid of said dreamer by having an aspect of them, or Metaphor as it's called, for support. During the expansion of the Somnoire, the Rover could enter these dreams while said Dreamers were more aware due to a piece of their original-selves becoming trapped in the Somnoire until they were released.

Gatekeepers: The two Gatekeepers that keep watch over the Somnoire. While the role of the Ivory Gatekeeper remains unknown, the Ebony Gatekeeper's duty is to erase useless dreams that won't help in vanquishing the Lament. They both, however, are tasked with protecting the realm from disruptive elements known to enter the Somnoire, as per their duty, ensuring the stability of its dream capacity. As such, both hold certain control over the Somnoire for their duties.

Tacet Discords: Due to the Somnoire containing traits similar to the Tacet Fields, Tacet Discords are capable of being born in the Somnoire. Though they are considered dangerous elements in the realm that shouldn't belong and are capable of exiting it if a gateway exists, which may cause a TD Outbreak.

Others: "Dorothy", an unknown figure who posed as "Cosmo", claims that she and her friends reside in the Somnoire itself. However, she also states that at some point they had lived in Solaris-3 before entering through the Gate like Rover had, though refused to explain further.
